import 'native_player_view.dart';
import 'subtitle_overlay.dart';

class EmbeddedPlayerView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EmbeddedPlayerView({required this.source, super.key});
  final ResolvedSource source;

  @override
  ConsumerState<EmbeddedPlayerView> createState() => _EmbeddedPlayerViewState();
}

class _EmbeddedPlayerViewState extends ConsumerState<EmbeddedPlayerView> {
  final bool _isMigratedToNative = false;
  late final WebViewController _controller;
  final List<String> _runtimeCandidates = [];
  late final AndroidMediaObserver _mediaObserver;
  StreamSubscription? _observerSub;

  final EmbeddedAudioCaptureManager _audioCaptureManager =
      EmbeddedAudioCaptureManager();
  EmbeddedCapabilityProbe _capabilityProbe =
      EmbeddedCapabilityProbe.standardWeb;

  ResolvedSource? _migratedSource;
  bool _isMigrating = false;
  String? _migrationErrorMessage;
  bool _aiSubtitlesEnabled = false;
  Timer? _positionUpdateTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _mediaObserver = AndroidMediaObserver()..startObserving();
    _observerSub = _mediaObserver.candidates.listen((candidate) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final uriStr = candidate.uri.toString();
        if (!_runtimeCandidates.contains(uriStr)) {
          _runtimeCandidates.insert(0, uriStr); // Prioritize new candidates
        }
      });
    });

    _controller = WebViewController()
      ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)
      ..addJavaScriptChannel(
        'MediaObserver',
        onMessageReceived: (message) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          final data = message.message;
          if (data.startsWith('pos:')) {
            final seconds = double.tryParse(data.substring(4)) ?? 0;
            ref
                .read(aiSchedulerProvider.notifier)
                .updatePlaybackPosition(
                  Duration(milliseconds: (seconds * 1000).toInt()),
                );
          } else {
            setState(() {
              if (!_runtimeCandidates.contains(data)) {
                _runtimeCandidates.insert(0, data);
              }
            });
          }
        },
      )
      ..setNavigationDelegate(
        NavigationDelegate(
          onPageFinished: (_) {
            _injectObserver();
            _startPositionPolling();
          },
        ),
      )
      ..loadRequest(widget.source.uri);

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      ref.read(aiSchedulerProvider.notifier).initializeForSource(widget.source);
    });
  }

  void _startPositionPolling() {
    _positionUpdateTimer?.cancel();
    _positionUpdateTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), (
      timer,
    ) {
      if (!mounted || _isMigratedToNative) {
        timer.cancel();
        return;
      }
      _controller.runJavaScript(r'''
        (function() {
          var v = document.querySelector('video');
          if (v) {
            MediaObserver.postMessage('pos:' + v.currentTime);
          }
        })();
      ''');
    });
  }

  Future<void> _injectObserver() async {
    const js = r'''
      (() => {
        const send = (value) => {
          if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length < 10) return;
          if (/\.m3u8|\.mpd|\.mp4|\.webm/i.test(value)) {
            MediaObserver.postMessage(value);
          }
        };
        document.querySelectorAll('video,source,iframe').forEach(el => send(el.src));
        const oldFetch = window.fetch;
        window.fetch = function(...args) { send(String(args[0])); return oldFetch.apply(this, args); };
        const oldOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
        XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function(method, url, ...rest) {
          send(String(url));
          return oldOpen.call(this, method, url, ...rest);
        };
        new PerformanceObserver(list => list.getEntries().forEach(e => send(e.name)))
          .observe({entryTypes: ['resource']});
      })();
    ''';
    await _controller.runJavaScript(js);
  }

  Future<void> _startNativeMigration() async {
    setState(() {
      _isMigrating = true;
      _migrationErrorMessage = null;
    });

    final targetCandidateUri = _runtimeCandidates.isNotEmpty
        ? Uri.tryParse(_runtimeCandidates.first) ?? widget.source.finalUri
        : widget.source.finalUri;

    final candidateSource = ResolvedSource(
      input: widget.source.input,
      normalizedUri: targetCandidateUri,
      finalUri: targetCandidateUri,
      kind: _inferKind(targetCandidateUri),
      playbackMode: PlaybackMode.native,
      discoveryMethod: DiscoveryMethod.runtime,
      capability: SourceCapability.full,
      requestContext: widget.source.requestContext,
      iframeChain: widget.source.iframeChain,
    );

    final success = await ref
        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
        .attemptMigrationToNative(source: candidateSource);

    if (!mounted) return;

    if (success) {
      setState(() {
        _migratedSource = candidateSource;
        _isMigrating = false;
      });
    } else {
      final migrationStatus = ref.read(migrationControllerProvider).status;
      setState(() {
        _isMigrating = false;
        _migrationErrorMessage =
            'Migration failed (status: ${migrationStatus.name}). Retaining Embedded WebView.';
        _capabilityProbe = const EmbeddedCapabilityProbe(
          canPlay: true,
          canPause: true,
          canReadPosition: true,
          canObserveSeek: true,
          canAccessAudio: false,
        );
      });
    }
  }

  MediaKind _inferKind(Uri uri) {
    final path = uri.path.toLowerCase();
    if (path.endsWith('.m3u8')) return MediaKind.hls;
    if (path.endsWith('.mpd')) return MediaKind.dash;
    return MediaKind.progressive;
  }

  /// Explicit user action to request audio capture consent for embedded AI subtitles.
  /// Never requested on app startup.
  Future<void> _requestEmbeddedAiConsent() async {
    final granted = await _audioCaptureManager.requestConsentAndStartCapture();
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (granted) {
      setState(() {
        _aiSubtitlesEnabled = true;
        _capabilityProbe = const EmbeddedCapabilityProbe(
          canPlay: true,
          canPause: true,
          canReadPosition: true,
          canObserveSeek: true,
          canAccessAudio: true,
        );
      });
    } else {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Audio capture permission denied. Embedded AI subtitles degraded gracefully.',
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _positionUpdateTimer?.cancel();
    _observerSub?.cancel();
    _mediaObserver.dispose();
    _audioCaptureManager.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_migratedSource != null) {
      return NativePlayerView(source: _migratedSource!);
    }

    final aiState = ref.watch(aiSchedulerProvider);

    return Stack(
      children: [
        WebViewWidget(controller: _controller),
        if (_aiSubtitlesEnabled && _capabilityProbe.canAccessAudio)
          SubtitleOverlay(segment: aiState.activeSegment),

        Positioned(
          left: 12,
          right: 12,
          bottom: 12,
          child: Card(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.auto_awesome,
                        color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC),
                        size: 18,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          _migrationErrorMessage != null
                              ? 'Embedded Fallback Mode (Capabilities: Play=${_capabilityProbe.canPlay}, Audio=${_capabilityProbe.canAccessAudio})'
                              : 'Runtime Media Candidates (${_runtimeCandidates.length})',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            fontSize: 13,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (!_isMigrating &&
                          !_isMigratedToNative &&
                          _migrationErrorMessage == null)
                        FilledButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _startNativeMigration,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.play_circle_fill, size: 16),
                          label: const Text('Migrate Native'),
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12,
                              vertical: 6,
                            ),
                            textStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                          ),
                        ),
                      if (_migrationErrorMessage != null &&
                          !_aiSubtitlesEnabled)
                        FilledButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _requestEmbeddedAiConsent,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.mic, size: 16),
                          label: const Text('Enable AI Subtitles'),
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF7C5CFC),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12,
                              vertical: 6,
                            ),
                            textStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  if (_isMigrating) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const LinearProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    const Text(
                      'Verifying candidate accessibility and preparing native player...',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.white70),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_migrationErrorMessage != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      _migrationErrorMessage!,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.orangeAccent,
                        fontSize: 11,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_aiSubtitlesEnabled) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    const Text(
                      'Embedded AI audio capture active. Synchronizing Vietnamese subtitles.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.greenAccent, fontSize: 11),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

```dart:lib/features/player/presentation/media_session_controller.dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../../../core/network/dio_provider.dart';
import '../../pipeline/data/dubbing_player_service.dart';
import '../../pipeline/presentation/ai_scheduler_controller.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/data/candidate_verifier.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../data/migration_controller.dart';
import '../data/native_media_session.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_session_snapshot.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_track.dart';

final nativeMediaSessionProvider = Provider<NativeMediaSession>((ref) {
  final session = NativeMediaSession();
  ref.onDispose(() => unawaited(session.close()));
  return session;
});

final migrationControllerProvider = Provider<NativeMigrationController>((ref) {
  final session = ref.watch(nativeMediaSessionProvider);
  final dio = ref.watch(dioProvider);
  final verifier = CandidateVerifier(dio);
  final diagnostics = ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider);

  final controller = NativeMigrationController(session, verifier, diagnostics);
  ref.onDispose(controller.dispose);
  return controller;
});

final dubbingPlayerServiceProvider = Provider<DubbingPlayerService>((ref) {
  final repo = ref.watch(dubbingRepositoryProvider);
  final service = DubbingPlayerService(repo);
  ref.onDispose(service.dispose);
  return service;
});

final mediaSessionControllerProvider =
    NotifierProvider<MediaSessionController, MediaSessionSnapshot>(
      MediaSessionController.new,
    );

class MediaSessionController extends Notifier<MediaSessionSnapshot> {
  @override
  MediaSessionSnapshot build() {
    _session = ref.watch(nativeMediaSessionProvider);
    _migrationController = ref.watch(migrationControllerProvider);
    _dubbingPlayer = ref.watch(dubbingPlayerServiceProvider);

    _subscription = _session.snapshotStream.listen((snapshot) {
      state = snapshot;
      _dubbingPlayer.syncWithPlayback(snapshot.position, snapshot.isPlaying);
    });

    _duckingSubscription = _dubbingPlayer.duckingStream.listen((shouldDuck) {
      _fadeVolume(shouldDuck ? 20.0 : 100.0);
    });

    ref.onDispose(() {
      _subscription?.cancel();
      _duckingSubscription?.cancel();
      _fadeTimer?.cancel();
    });

    return MediaSessionSnapshot.idle;
  }

  late final NativeMediaSession _session;
  late final NativeMigrationController _migrationController;
  late final DubbingPlayerService _dubbingPlayer;
  StreamSubscription<MediaSessionSnapshot>? _subscription;
  StreamSubscription<bool>? _duckingSubscription;
  Timer? _fadeTimer;

  void _fadeVolume(double targetVolume) {
    _fadeTimer?.cancel();
    final startVolume = state.volume;
    const steps = 10;
    const duration = Duration(milliseconds: 200);
    final stepDuration = Duration(
      milliseconds: duration.inMilliseconds ~/ steps,
    );
    final volumeDelta = (targetVolume - startVolume) / steps;

    int currentStep = 0;
    _fadeTimer = Timer.periodic(stepDuration, (timer) {
      currentStep++;
      final nextVolume = startVolume + (volumeDelta * currentStep);
      _session.setVolume(nextVolume.clamp(0.0, 100.0));

      if (currentStep >= steps) {
        timer.cancel();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> openSource(ResolvedSource source) async {
    await _session.open(source);
  }

  Future<void> play() => _session.play();
  Future<void> pause() => _session.pause();
  Future<void> seek(Duration position) => _session.seek(position);
  Future<void> setPlaybackRate(double rate) => _session.setPlaybackRate(rate);

  Future<void> selectVideoTrack(VideoTrack track) =>
      _session.selectVideoTrack(track);
  Future<void> selectAudioTrack(AudioTrack track) =>
      _session.selectAudioTrack(track);
  Future<void> selectSubtitleTrack(PlayerSubtitleTrack? track) =>
      _session.selectSubtitleTrack(track);

  Future<bool> attemptMigrationToNative({
    required ResolvedSource source,
    Duration? capturedPosition,
  }) async {
    final result = await _migrationController.attemptMigration(
      source: source,
      capturedPosition: capturedPosition,
    );
    return result.isSuccess;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:media_kit_video/media_kit_video.dart';

import '../../../core/constants/app_constants.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/presentation/diagnostic_log_overlay.dart';
import '../../pipeline/presentation/ai_scheduler_controller.dart';
import '../../pipeline/presentation/dubbing_controller.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_session_snapshot.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_track.dart';
import '../domain/entities/player_state.dart';
import 'media_session_controller.dart';
import 'subtitle_overlay.dart';

class NativePlayerView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const NativePlayerView({required this.source, super.key});
  final ResolvedSource source;

  @override
  ConsumerState<NativePlayerView> createState() => _NativePlayerViewState();
}

class _NativePlayerViewState extends ConsumerState<NativePlayerView> {
  VideoController? _videoController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) async {
      final ctrl = ref.read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier);
      await ctrl.openSource(widget.source);

      final session = ref.read(nativeMediaSessionProvider);
      final p = session.player;

      if (p != null && mounted) {
        final controller = VideoController(p);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _videoController = controller;
          });
        }
      }

      ref.read(aiSchedulerProvider.notifier).initializeForSource(widget.source);
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_videoController == null) {
      return const ColoredBox(
        color: Colors.black,
        child: Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC)),
        ),
      );
    }

    final aiState = ref.watch(aiSchedulerProvider);
    final sessionSnapshot = ref.watch(mediaSessionControllerProvider);
    final player = ref.read(nativeMediaSessionProvider).player;

    ref.listen<AiSchedulerState>(aiSchedulerProvider, (previous, next) {
      if (player == null) return;

      if (next.isBufferingForAi && player.state.playing) {
        ref.read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier).pause();
      } else if (!next.isBufferingForAi && previous?.isBufferingForAi == true) {
        ref.read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier).play();
      }
    });

    if (sessionSnapshot.status == PlayerStatus.error) {
      return ColoredBox(
        color: Colors.black,
        child: Center(
          child: Card(
            color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
            margin: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.error_outline,
                    color: Colors.redAccent,
                    size: 48,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  const Text(
                    'Native Player Error',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    sessionSnapshot.error?.message ?? 'Unknown playback error',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white70),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => ref
                        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
                        .openSource(widget.source),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                    label: const Text('Retry Playback'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ColoredBox(
      color: Colors.black,
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: [
          Center(child: Video(controller: _videoController!)),
          SubtitleOverlay(segment: aiState.activeSegment),
          _TrackSelectorOverlay(sessionSnapshot: sessionSnapshot),
          if (kDebugMode)
            Positioned(
              bottom: 80,
              right: 16,
              child: FloatingActionButton.small(
                backgroundColor: Colors.black54,
                child: const Icon(Icons.bug_report, color: Colors.redAccent),
                onPressed: () {
                  showModalBottomSheet(
                    context: context,
                    isScrollControlled: true,
                    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                    builder: (context) => const DiagnosticLogOverlay(),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          if (aiState.isBufferingForAi)
            Container(
              color: Colors.black54,
              child: Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Text(
                      'Refilling Subtitle Buffer (${aiState.subtitleAhead.inSeconds}s / ${AppConstants.initialSubtitleBuffer.inSeconds}s)',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    const Text(
                      'Video paused to guarantee synchronized Vietnamese subtitles',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _TrackSelectorOverlay extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _TrackSelectorOverlay({required this.sessionSnapshot});
  final MediaSessionSnapshot sessionSnapshot;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final audioTracks = sessionSnapshot.trackSet.audioTracks;
    final subtitleTracks = sessionSnapshot.trackSet.subtitleTracks;

    if (audioTracks.length <= 1 && subtitleTracks.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Positioned(
      top: 12,
      right: 12,
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (audioTracks.length > 1) ...[
                PopupMenuButton<AudioTrack>(
                  icon: const Icon(
                    Icons.audiotrack,
                    size: 18,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  tooltip: 'Select Audio Track',
                  onSelected: (track) {
                    ref
                        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
                        .selectAudioTrack(track);
                  },
                  itemBuilder: (context) {
                    return audioTracks.map((a) {
                      return PopupMenuItem<AudioTrack>(
                        value: a,
                        child: Text('${a.label} (${a.language ?? 'unknown'})'),
                      );
                    }).toList();
                  },
                ),
              ],
              IconButton(
                icon: Icon(
                  ref.watch(dubbingControllerProvider)
                      ? Icons.record_voice_over
                      : Icons.voice_over_off,
                  size: 18,
                  color: ref.watch(dubbingControllerProvider)
                      ? const Color(0xFF7C5CFC)
                      : Colors.white,
                ),
                tooltip: 'AI Vietnamese Dubbing',
                onPressed: () => ref
                    .read(dubbingControllerProvider.notifier)
                    .toggleDubbing(),
              ),
              if (subtitleTracks.isNotEmpty) ...[
                PopupMenuButton<PlayerSubtitleTrack?>(
                  icon: const Icon(
                    Icons.subtitles,
                    size: 18,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  tooltip: 'Select Subtitle Track',
                  onSelected: (track) {
                    ref
                        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
                        .selectSubtitleTrack(track);
                  },
                  itemBuilder: (context) {
                    return [
                      const PopupMenuItem<PlayerSubtitleTrack?>(
                        value: null,
                        child: Text('Off / AI Pipeline Default'),
                      ),
                      ...subtitleTracks.map((s) {
                        return PopupMenuItem<PlayerSubtitleTrack?>(
                          value: s,
                          child: Text('${s.label} [${s.classification.name}]'),
                        );
                      }),
                    ];
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../app/theme/app_colors.dart';
import '../../pipeline/domain/ai_pipeline.dart';

class SubtitleOverlay extends StatelessWidget {
  const SubtitleOverlay({required this.segment, super.key});

  final TimedTextSegment? segment;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (segment == null || segment!.text.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Positioned(
      left: 16,
      right: 16,

enum ModelDownloadState { notDownloaded, downloading, ready, failed }

class ModelDownloadProgress {
  const ModelDownloadProgress({
    required this.modelId,
    required this.state,
    required this.downloadedBytes,
    required this.totalBytes,
    this.currentFile,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final String modelId;
  final ModelDownloadState state;
  final int downloadedBytes;
  final int totalBytes;
  final String? currentFile;
  final String? errorMessage;

  double get progress =>
      totalBytes > 0 ? (downloadedBytes / totalBytes).clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
}

class ModelDownloadException implements Exception {
  ModelDownloadException(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  String toString() => message;
}

class ModelIntegrityException implements Exception {
  ModelIntegrityException(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  String toString() => 'ModelIntegrityException: $message';
}

const String _whisperBase =

    AiModelManifest(
      id: 'vad_silero',
      type: AiModelType.vad,
      version: 'git-60b7ffa',
      languages: ['all'],

  AiModelManifest? manifestById(String modelId) {
    for (final m in defaultManifests) {
      if (m.id == modelId) return m;
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<Directory> get _modelsDir async {
    final docs = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    final dir = Directory('${docs.path}/models');
    if (!await dir.exists()) {
      await dir.create(recursive: true);
    }
    return dir;
  }

  Future<Directory> getModelDir(String modelId) async {
    final root = await _modelsDir;
    final dir = Directory('${root.path}/$modelId');
    if (!await dir.exists()) {
      await dir.create(recursive: true);
    }
    return dir;
  }

  Future<File> getModelFile(String modelId, String fileName) async {
    final dir = await getModelDir(modelId);
    return File('${dir.path}/$fileName');
  }

  Future<bool> isModelDownloaded(String modelId) async {
    final manifest = manifestById(modelId);
    if (manifest == null) return false;

    final dir = await getModelDir(modelId);
    final marker = File('${dir.path}/$_readyMarker');
    if (!await marker.exists()) return false;

    try {
      final data = jsonDecode(await marker.readAsString());
      if (data is! Map || data['version'] != manifest.version) return false;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }

    for (final f in manifest.files) {
      final file = File('${dir.path}/${f.name}');
      if (!await file.exists()) return false;
      if (f.sha256 != null && await file.length() != f.bytes) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  Future<void> downloadModel(AiModelManifest manifest) async {
    if (!_active.add(manifest.id)) return;

    var completedBytes = 0;
    try {
      final dir = await getModelDir(manifest.id);
      final marker = File('${dir.path}/$_readyMarker');
      if (await marker.exists()) await marker.delete();

      for (final spec in manifest.files) {
        await _downloadFile(
          manifest: manifest,
          spec: spec,
          dir: dir,
          completedBytes: completedBytes,
        );
        completedBytes += spec.bytes;
      }

      await marker.writeAsString(
        jsonEncode({
          'version': manifest.version,
          'files': manifest.files.map((f) => f.name).toList(),
        }),
      );

      _emit(
        ModelDownloadProgress(
          modelId: manifest.id,
          state: ModelDownloadState.ready,
          downloadedBytes: manifest.totalBytes,
          totalBytes: manifest.totalBytes,
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      _emit(
        ModelDownloadProgress(
          modelId: manifest.id,
          state: ModelDownloadState.failed,
          downloadedBytes: completedBytes,
          totalBytes: manifest.totalBytes,
          errorMessage: e.toString(),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      _active.remove(manifest.id);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _downloadFile({
    required AiModelManifest manifest,
    required ModelFile spec,
    required Directory dir,
    required int completedBytes,
  }) async {
    final target = File('${dir.path}/${spec.name}');
    final tmp = File('${target.path}.tmp');

    if (await target.exists()) {
      try {
        await _verify(target, spec);
        return;
      } on ModelIntegrityException {
        await target.delete();
      }
    }

    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      var existing = await tmp.exists() ? await tmp.length() : 0;

      if (spec.sha256 != null && existing > spec.bytes) {
        await tmp.delete();
        existing = 0;
      }

      try {
        final alreadyComplete = spec.sha256 != null && existing == spec.bytes;
        if (!alreadyComplete) {
          await _dio.download(
            spec.url,
            tmp.path,
            options: Options(
              headers: existing > 0 ? {'Range': 'bytes=$existing-'} : null,
              receiveTimeout: const Duration(minutes: 5),
            ),
            fileAccessMode: existing > 0
                ? FileAccessMode.append
                : FileAccessMode.write,
            deleteOnError: false,
            onReceiveProgress: (received, total) {
              _emit(
                ModelDownloadProgress(
                  modelId: manifest.id,
                  state: ModelDownloadState.downloading,
                  downloadedBytes: completedBytes + existing + received,
                  totalBytes: manifest.totalBytes,
                  currentFile: spec.name,
                ),
              );
            },
          );
        }

        await _verify(tmp, spec);

        if (await target.exists()) await target.delete();
        await tmp.rename(target.path);
        return;
      } on ModelIntegrityException {
        if (await tmp.exists()) await tmp.delete();
        if (attempt == 1) rethrow;
      } on DioException catch (e) {
        if (e.response?.statusCode == 416 && attempt == 0) {
          if (await tmp.exists()) await tmp.delete();
          continue;
        }
        rethrow;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _verify(File file, ModelFile spec) async {
    final length = await file.length();
    if (length == 0) {
      throw ModelIntegrityException('${spec.name}: file rỗng');
    }

    final expectedHash = spec.sha256;
    if (expectedHash != null) {
      if (length != spec.bytes) {
        throw ModelIntegrityException(
          '${spec.name}: sai kích thước ($length != ${spec.bytes})',
        );
      }
      final actual = await Sha256Util.computeFileHash(file);
      if (actual.toLowerCase() != expectedHash.toLowerCase()) {
        throw ModelIntegrityException('${spec.name}: sai SHA-256');
      }
    } else if (spec.name.endsWith('.json')) {
      try {
        jsonDecode(await file.readAsString());
      } catch (_) {
        throw ModelIntegrityException('${spec.name}: JSON không hợp lệ');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteModel(String modelId) async {
    final root = await _modelsDir;
    final dir = Directory('${root.path}/$modelId');
    if (await dir.exists()) {
      await dir.delete(recursive: true);
    }
    _emit(
      ModelDownloadProgress(
        modelId: modelId,
        state: ModelDownloadState.notDownloaded,
        downloadedBytes: 0,
        totalBytes: 0,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _emit(ModelDownloadProgress p) {
    if (!_progressController.isClosed) _progressController.add(p);
  }

  void dispose() {
    _progressController.close();
  }
}

final modelManagerRepositoryProvider = Provider<ModelManagerRepository>((ref) {
  final repo = ModelManagerRepository(ref.watch(dioProvider));
  ref.onDispose(repo.dispose);
  return repo;
});

## lib/features/settings/domain/model_manifest.dart
```dart:lib/features/settings/domain/model_manifest.dart
enum AiModelType { stt, translation, tts, vad }

/// Một file thuộc về model (một model có thể gồm nhiều file).
class ModelFile {
  const ModelFile({
    required this.name,
    required this.url,
    required this.bytes,
    this.sha256,
  });

  /// Tên file khi lưu trên máy (nằm trong thư mục models/modelId/).
  final String name;

  /// URL đã ghim theo commit để nội dung không đổi.
  final String url;

  /// Kích thước chính xác (byte) nếu có [sha256]; nếu không thì chỉ là
  /// số xấp xỉ, dùng để hiển thị tiến độ.
  final int bytes;

  /// SHA-256 (64 ký tự hex). Null với file nhỏ chưa tính hash:
  /// khi đó chỉ kiểm tra file không rỗng (và JSON hợp lệ nếu là .json).
  final String? sha256;

  Uri get uri => Uri.parse(url);
}

class AiModelManifest {
  const AiModelManifest({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.version,
    required this.files,
    required this.languages,
  });

  final String id;
  final AiModelType type;
  final String version;
  final List<ModelFile> files;
  final List<String> languages;

  int get totalBytes => files.fold<int>(0, (sum, f) => sum + f.bytes);
}

                    ),

            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),

  }

  Widget _buildQualityCard({
    required int index,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {

    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 8),
      backgroundColor: isSelected ? AppColors.primaryGlow : AppColors.surfaceCard,
      borderColor: isSelected ? AppColors.primaryLight : AppColors.surfaceCardBorder,
      onTap: () => setState(() => _qualityIndex = index),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Icon(
            icon,
            color: isSelected ? AppColors.primaryLight : AppColors.textMuted,
            size: 22,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            title,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: isSelected ? AppColors.textPrimary : AppColors.textMuted,

          ),
          Text(
            subtitle,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: AppColors.textMuted),
          ),

      ),

  void _showLangPicker(String title, Function(String) onSelect) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: AppColors.surfaceCard,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (context) {

          'Tiếng Việt',
          'Tiếng Trung (Giản thể)',
          'Tiếng Nhật',
          'Tiếng Hàn',
          'Tiếng Pháp',
          'Tiếng Đức',
        ];

        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),

    );
  }

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ModelManagerPage extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const ModelManagerPage({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<ModelManagerPage> createState() => _ModelManagerPageState();
}

class _ModelManagerPageState extends ConsumerState<ModelManagerPage> {
  final Map<String, ModelDownloadProgress> _progressMap = {};
  StreamSubscription<ModelDownloadProgress>? _progressSub;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _progressSub = ref
        .read(modelManagerRepositoryProvider)
        .progressStream
        .listen((progress) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() {
            _progressMap[progress.modelId] = progress;
          });
        });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _progressSub?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final repo = ref.watch(modelManagerRepositoryProvider);
    final manifests = ModelManagerRepository.defaultManifests;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Quản lý AI Models Offline'),
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
      ),
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(gradient: AppColors.backgroundGradient),
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),

                  SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        'Đã sử dụng: 1.2 GB',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: AppColors.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),

                        'Trống: 124 GB',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,

class _ModelCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ModelCard({
    required this.manifest,
    required this.progress,
    required this.repo,
  });

  final AiModelManifest manifest;
  final ModelDownloadProgress? progress;
  final ModelManagerRepository repo;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final sizeMb = (manifest.totalBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1);
    final isDownloading = progress?.state == ModelDownloadState.downloading;
    final isFailed = progress?.state == ModelDownloadState.failed;
    final isReady = progress?.state == ModelDownloadState.ready;

    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  _typeIcon(manifest.type),
                  color: AppColors.primaryLight,
                  size: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      _friendlyName(manifest.id),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        fontSize: 15,
                        color: AppColors.textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      '${manifest.version} • $sizeMb MB',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: AppColors.textMuted,
                        fontSize: 12,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              FutureBuilder<bool>(
                future: repo.isModelDownloaded(manifest.id),
                builder: (context, snapshot) {
                  final isDownloaded = snapshot.data ?? false;

                  if (isDownloading) {
                    return const SizedBox(
                      width: 24,
                      height: 24,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 2,
                        color: AppColors.primaryLight,
                      ),
                    );
                  }

                  if (isDownloaded || isReady) {
                    return IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                        color: AppColors.success,
                      ),
                      onPressed: () => _showDeleteDialog(context),
                    );
                  }

                  return IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.download_rounded,
                      color: AppColors.primaryLight,
                    ),
                    onPressed: () => repo.downloadModel(manifest),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (isDownloading && progress != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
              child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: progress!.progress,
                minHeight: 6,
                backgroundColor: AppColors.surfaceCardBorder,
                valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation(
                  AppColors.primaryLight,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Đang tải... ${(progress!.progress * 100).toInt()}%',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: AppColors.textSecondary,
                  ),
                ),
                Text(
                  '${(progress!.downloadedBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)} / $sizeMb MB',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: AppColors.textMuted,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
          if (isFailed) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              'Lỗi: ${progress?.errorMessage ?? "Tải thất bại"}',
              style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.error, fontSize: 11),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => repo.downloadModel(manifest),
              child: const Text('Thử lại', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showDeleteDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: AppColors.surfaceCard,
        title: const Text(
          'Xóa Model?',
          style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.textPrimary),
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa model ${manifest.id}? Bạn sẽ cần tải lại để sử dụng tính năng này.',
          style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.textSecondary),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('Hủy'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              repo.deleteModel(manifest.id);
              Navigator.pop(context);
            },
            child: const Text('Xóa', style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.error)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _friendlyName(String id) {
    if (id.contains('whisper')) return 'Whisper STT (Nhận dạng giọng nói)';
    if (id.contains('opus')) return 'Opus-MT (Dịch Anh-Việt)';
    if (id.contains('piper')) return 'Piper TTS (Lồng tiếng Việt)';
    if (id.contains('silero')) return 'Silero VAD (Lọc tiếng động)';
    return id;
  }

  IconData _typeIcon(AiModelType type) => switch (type) {
    AiModelType.stt => Icons.mic_rounded,
    AiModelType.translation => Icons.translate_rounded,
    AiModelType.tts => Icons.record_voice_over_rounded,
    AiModelType.vad => Icons.graphic_eq_rounded,
  };
}

## lib/features/source_resolver/data/android_media_observer.dart
```dart:lib/features/source_resolver/data/android_media_observer.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import 'media_candidate.dart';
import '../domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';

class AndroidMediaObserver {
  AndroidMediaObserver();

  static const _eventChannel = EventChannel(
    'local_ai_video_translator/media_events',
  );
  StreamSubscription<dynamic>? _subscription;
  final _candidateController = StreamController<MediaCandidate>.broadcast();

  Stream<MediaCandidate> get candidates => _candidateController.stream;

  void startObserving() {
    _subscription?.cancel();
    try {
      _subscription = _eventChannel.receiveBroadcastStream().listen(
        _onEvent,
        onError: (error) {
          // Event channel error ignored gracefully
        },
      );
    } catch (_) {
      // Platform channel not available in non-Android environment
    }
  }

  void _onEvent(dynamic event) {
    if (event is! Map) return;
    final urlStr = event['url'] as String?;
    if (urlStr == null || urlStr.isEmpty) return;

    final uri = Uri.tryParse(urlStr);
    if (uri == null || !(uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'https')) return;

    final path = uri.path.toLowerCase();
    MediaKind? kind;
    if (path.endsWith('.m3u8')) {
      kind = MediaKind.hls;
    } else if (path.endsWith('.mpd')) {
      kind = MediaKind.dash;
    } else if (['.mp4', '.webm', '.mkv', '.m4v'].any(path.endsWith)) {
      kind = MediaKind.progressive;
    }

    if (kind != null) {
      _candidateController.add(
        MediaCandidate(
          uri: uri,
          kind: kind,
          method: DiscoveryMethod.runtime,
          score: 80,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void stopObserving() {
    _subscription?.cancel();
    _subscription = null;
  }

  void dispose() {
    stopObserving();
    _candidateController.close();
  }
}

## lib/features/source_resolver/data/candidate_verifier.dart
```dart:lib/features/source_resolver/data/candidate_verifier.dart
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import 'media_candidate.dart';

class VerifiedCandidateResult {
  const VerifiedCandidateResult({
    required this.candidate,
    required this.isAccessible,
    required this.statusCode,
    required this.contentType,
    required this.contentLength,
    this.error,
  });

  final MediaCandidate candidate;
  final bool isAccessible;
  final int statusCode;
  final String contentType;
  final int contentLength;
  final String? error;
}

class CandidateVerifier {
  CandidateVerifier(this._dio);

  final Dio _dio;
  static const _nativeChannel = MethodChannel(
    'local_ai_video_translator/native_resolver',
  );

  Future<VerifiedCandidateResult> verify(
    MediaCandidate candidate, {
    Map<String, String>? headers,
  }) async {
    // Try native Android verification first
    try {
      final res = await _nativeChannel
          .invokeMethod<Map<dynamic, dynamic>>('verifyCandidate', {
            'url': candidate.uri.toString(),
            'headers': headers ?? <String, String>{},
          });
      if (res != null) {
        final isAccessible = res['isAccessible'] as bool? ?? false;
        final statusCode = res['statusCode'] as int? ?? -1;
        final contentType = res['contentType'] as String? ?? '';
        final contentLength = res['contentLength'] as int? ?? -1;
        final error = res['error'] as String?;

        final updatedKind =
            _detectKindFromContentType(contentType) ?? candidate.kind;
        final status = isAccessible
            ? CandidateValidationStatus.valid
            : (statusCode == 403 || statusCode == 401
                  ? CandidateValidationStatus.requiresEmbeddedSession
                  : CandidateValidationStatus.invalid);

        final updatedCandidate = candidate.copyWith(
          kind: updatedKind,
          score: isAccessible ? (candidate.score + 25) : candidate.score,
          validationStatus: status,
          statusCode: statusCode,
          contentType: contentType,
          contentLength: contentLength,
          rejectionReason: isAccessible ? null : error ?? 'HTTP $statusCode',
        );

        return VerifiedCandidateResult(
          candidate: updatedCandidate,
          isAccessible: isAccessible,
          statusCode: statusCode,
          contentType: contentType,
          contentLength: contentLength,
          error: error,
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Native channel fallback
    }

    return _verifyWithDio(candidate, headers: headers);
  }

  Future<VerifiedCandidateResult> _verifyWithDio(
    MediaCandidate candidate, {
    Map<String, String>? headers,
  }) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.head<void>(
        candidate.uri.toString(),
        options: Options(
          headers: headers,
          validateStatus: (status) => status != null && status < 400,
        ),
      );
      final statusCode = response.statusCode ?? 200;
      final contentType = response.headers.value('content-type') ?? '';
      final contentLengthStr = response.headers.value('content-length');
      final contentLength = int.tryParse(contentLengthStr ?? '') ?? -1;

      final updatedKind =
          _detectKindFromContentType(contentType) ?? candidate.kind;

      final updatedCandidate = candidate.copyWith(
        kind: updatedKind,
        score: candidate.score + 20,
        validationStatus: CandidateValidationStatus.valid,
        statusCode: statusCode,
        contentType: contentType,
        contentLength: contentLength,
      );

      return VerifiedCandidateResult(
        candidate: updatedCandidate,
        isAccessible: true,
        statusCode: statusCode,
        contentType: contentType,
        contentLength: contentLength,
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      final statusCode = e.response?.statusCode ?? -1;
      final status = (statusCode == 403 || statusCode == 401)
          ? CandidateValidationStatus.requiresEmbeddedSession
          : CandidateValidationStatus.invalid;

      final updatedCandidate = candidate.copyWith(
        validationStatus: status,
        statusCode: statusCode,
        contentType: '',
        contentLength: -1,
        rejectionReason: e.message ?? 'HTTP $statusCode',
      );

      return VerifiedCandidateResult(
        candidate: updatedCandidate,
        isAccessible: false,
        statusCode: statusCode,
        contentType: '',
        contentLength: -1,
        error: e.message,
      );
    }
  }

  MediaKind? _detectKindFromContentType(String contentType) {
    final lower = contentType.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.contains('mpegurl') || lower.contains('m3u8')) {
      return MediaKind.hls;
    }
    if (lower.contains('dash+xml')) {
      return MediaKind.dash;
    }
    if (lower.startsWith('video/')) {
      return MediaKind.progressive;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

## lib/features/source_resolver/data/html_media_parser.dart
```dart:lib/features/source_resolver/data/html_media_parser.dart
import '../domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import 'media_candidate.dart';

class ParsedHtmlMedia {
  const ParsedHtmlMedia({required this.candidates, required this.iframes});
  final List<MediaCandidate> candidates;
  final List<Uri> iframes;
}

class HtmlMediaParser {
  const HtmlMediaParser();

  ParsedHtmlMedia parse(String html, Uri baseUri) {
    final candidates = <MediaCandidate>[];
    final iframes = <Uri>[];

    // Refined regex for iframes to handle - and _ in attributes
    final iframeRx = RegExp(
      r'''<iframe[^>]+?src=["']([^"']+)["']''',
      caseSensitive: false,
    );
    for (final match in iframeRx.allMatches(html)) {
      final uriStr = match.group(1);
      if (uriStr != null) {
        final uri = _absolute(baseUri, uriStr);
        if (uri != null) {
          iframes.add(uri);
        }
      }
    }

    // Refined regex for common JS-embedded media sources
    final urlRx = RegExp(
      r'''(?:src|file|url|source|data-src)\s*[:=]\s*["']([^"']+\.(?:m3u8|mpd|mp4|webm|mkv)(?:\?[^"']*)?)["']''',
      caseSensitive: false,
    );
    for (final match in urlRx.allMatches(html)) {
      final uri = _absolute(baseUri, match.group(1));
      if (uri != null) {
        final kind = _kind(uri);
        if (kind != null) {
          candidates.add(
            MediaCandidate(
              uri: uri,
              kind: kind,
              method: DiscoveryMethod.htmlVideo,
              score: 60,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // Direct URL discovery with support for escaped slashes and common video extensions
    final rawMediaRx = RegExp(
      r'''https?[:\\]+[^"'\s<>]+?\.(?:m3u8|mpd|mp4|webm|mkv)(?:\?[^"'\s<>]*)?''',
      caseSensitive: false,
    );
    for (final match in rawMediaRx.allMatches(html)) {
      final raw = match.group(0)?.replaceAll(r'\/', '/');
      final uri = raw == null ? null : Uri.tryParse(raw);
      if (uri != null) {
        final kind = _kind(uri);
        if (kind != null) {
          candidates.add(
            MediaCandidate(
              uri: uri,
              kind: kind,
              method: DiscoveryMethod.htmlVideo,
              score: 70,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return ParsedHtmlMedia(
      candidates: _dedupe(candidates),
      iframes: iframes.toSet().toList(),
    );
  }

  Uri? _absolute(Uri base, String? raw) {
    if (raw == null ||
        raw.startsWith('blob:') ||
        raw.startsWith('javascript:')) {
      return null;
    }
    final normalized = raw.replaceAll('&amp;', '&').trim();
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(normalized);
    if (uri == null) {
      return null;
    }
    return uri.hasScheme ? uri : base.resolveUri(uri);
  }

  MediaKind? _kind(Uri uri) {
    final path = uri.path.toLowerCase();
    if (path.endsWith('.m3u8')) {
      return MediaKind.hls;
    }
    if (path.endsWith('.mpd')) {
      return MediaKind.dash;
    }
    if (['.mp4', '.webm', '.mkv', '.m4v'].any(path.endsWith)) {
      return MediaKind.progressive;
    }
    return null;
  }

  List<MediaCandidate> _dedupe(List<MediaCandidate> input) {
    final seen = <String>{};
    return input.where((item) => seen.add(item.uri.toString())).toList();
  }
}

## lib/features/source_resolver/data/media_candidate.dart
```dart:lib/features/source_resolver/data/media_candidate.dart
import '../domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';

enum CandidateValidationStatus {
  valid,
  invalid,
  requiresEmbeddedSession,
  unknown,
}

class MediaCandidate {
  const MediaCandidate({
    required this.uri,
    required this.kind,
    required this.method,
    this.score = 0,
    this.validationStatus = CandidateValidationStatus.unknown,
    this.statusCode = -1,
    this.contentType = '',
    this.contentLength = -1,
    this.rejectionReason,
  });

  final Uri uri;
  final MediaKind kind;
  final DiscoveryMethod method;
  final int score;
  final CandidateValidationStatus validationStatus;
  final int statusCode;
  final String contentType;
  final int contentLength;
  final String? rejectionReason;

  MediaCandidate copyWith({
    Uri? uri,
    MediaKind? kind,
    DiscoveryMethod? method,
    int? score,
    CandidateValidationStatus? validationStatus,
    int? statusCode,
    String? contentType,
    int? contentLength,
    String? rejectionReason,
  }) {
    return MediaCandidate(
      uri: uri ?? this.uri,
      kind: kind ?? this.kind,
      method: method ?? this.method,
      score: score ?? this.score,
      validationStatus: validationStatus ?? this.validationStatus,
      statusCode: statusCode ?? this.statusCode,
      contentType: contentType ?? this.contentType,
      contentLength: contentLength ?? this.contentLength,
      rejectionReason: rejectionReason ?? this.rejectionReason,
    );
  }
}

import '../../../core/constants/app_constants.dart';
import '../../../core/errors/app_exception.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/media_url.dart';
import '../domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../domain/repositories/source_resolver_repository.dart';
import 'candidate_verifier.dart';
import 'html_media_parser.dart';
import 'media_candidate.dart';

class SourceResolverRepositoryImpl implements SourceResolverRepository {
  SourceResolverRepositoryImpl(
    this._dio,
    this._parser, [
    CandidateVerifier? verifier,
  ]) : _verifier = verifier ?? CandidateVerifier(_dio);

  final Dio _dio;
  final HtmlMediaParser _parser;
  final CandidateVerifier _verifier;

  /// Limit for reading probe data (HTML/Manifests) to prevent OOM
  static const int _kMaxProbeBytes = 1 * 1024 * 1024; // 1 MB

  @override
  Future<ResolvedSource> resolve(String input) async {
    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();
    final trimmed = input.trim();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {
      throw const InvalidInputException('Video URL is empty.');
    }

    final normalized = _normalizeInput(trimmed);
    final diagnostics = <String>[];
    final rejectionReasons = <String, String>{};
    final cancelToken = CancelToken();

    // Initialize RequestContext with Referer and User-Agent based on the input URL
    final requestContext = RequestContext(
      userAgent: AppConstants.defaultUserAgent,
      referer: normalized.scheme.startsWith('http') ? normalized.toString() : null,
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': AppConstants.defaultUserAgent,
        if (normalized.scheme.startsWith('http')) 'Referer': normalized.toString(),
      },
    );

    try {
      final result = await _resolveInternal(
        normalized,
        originInput: trimmed,
        depth: 0,
        visited: <String>{},
        redirectChain: <Uri>[normalized],
        iframeChain: <Uri>[],
        diagnostics: diagnostics,
        rejectionReasons: rejectionReasons,
        stopwatch: stopwatch,
        cancelToken: cancelToken,
        requestContext: requestContext,
      );

      stopwatch.stop();
      return result;
    } catch (e) {
      cancelToken.cancel('Resolution failed or aborted');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Uri _normalizeInput(String input) {
    if (input.startsWith('/') ||
        input.startsWith('file://') ||
        input.startsWith('content://')) {
      return input.startsWith('/') ? Uri.file(input) : Uri.parse(input);
    }
    var value = input;
    if (!value.contains('://')) {
      value = 'https://$value';
    }
    return Uri.parse(value);
  }

  Future<ResolvedSource> _resolveInternal(
    Uri currentUri, {
    required String originInput,
    required int depth,
    required Set<String> visited,
    required List<Uri> redirectChain,
    required List<Uri> iframeChain,
    required List<String> diagnostics,
    required Map<String, String> rejectionReasons,
    required Stopwatch stopwatch,
    required CancelToken cancelToken,
    required RequestContext requestContext,
  }) async {
    if (depth > AppConstants.maxIframeDepth) {
      throw const ResolutionException('Maximum iframe depth reached.');
    }

    if (currentUri.scheme == 'file' || currentUri.scheme == 'content') {
      diagnostics.add('Local file resolved.');
      return ResolvedSource(
        input: originInput,
        normalizedUri: currentUri,
        finalUri: currentUri,
        kind: MediaKind.localFile,
        playbackMode: PlaybackMode.native,
        discoveryMethod: DiscoveryMethod.localFile,
        capability: SourceCapability.full,
        resolutionDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,
        diagnostics: diagnostics,
        requestContext: requestContext,
      );
    }

    // Step 1: Direct media URL classification
    final initialKind = _toMediaKind(MediaUrl.classify(currentUri.toString()));
    if (initialKind != null) {
      final directCandidate = MediaCandidate(
        uri: currentUri,
        kind: initialKind,
        method: DiscoveryMethod.input,
        score: 100,
      );
      final verified = await _verifier.verify(directCandidate, headers: requestContext.headers);
      if (verified.isAccessible) {
        diagnostics.add(
          'Direct media URL verified accessible (status=${verified.statusCode}, type=${verified.contentType}).',
        );
        return ResolvedSource(
          input: originInput,
          normalizedUri: currentUri,
          finalUri: verified.candidate.uri,
          kind: verified.candidate.kind,
          playbackMode: PlaybackMode.native,
          discoveryMethod: DiscoveryMethod.input,
          capability: SourceCapability.full,
          redirectChain: redirectChain,
          iframeChain: iframeChain,
          candidates: [verified.candidate],
          selectedCandidate: verified.candidate,
          resolutionDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,
          diagnostics: diagnostics,
          requestContext: requestContext,
        );
      } else {
        rejectionReasons[currentUri.toString()] =
            verified.error ?? 'Direct candidate inaccessible';
        diagnostics.add(
          'Direct candidate rejected: ${rejectionReasons[currentUri.toString()]}',
        );
      }
    }

    if (!visited.add(currentUri.toString())) {
      throw const ResolutionException('Iframe cycle detected.');
    }

    try {
      final probeResult = await _probe(currentUri, cancelToken, requestContext);
      final finalUri = probeResult.finalUri;
      if (finalUri != currentUri && !redirectChain.contains(finalUri)) {
        redirectChain.add(finalUri);
      }

      final contentType = probeResult.contentType;
      final body = probeResult.body;

      // Step 2: Response signature classification
      final byResponse = _detectResponse(finalUri, contentType, body);
      if (byResponse != null) {
        diagnostics.add(
          'Detected by HTTP response content-type/signature: $contentType',
        );
        final candidate = MediaCandidate(
          uri: finalUri,
          kind: byResponse,
          method: DiscoveryMethod.htmlVideo,
          score: 90,
          validationStatus: CandidateValidationStatus.valid,
        );
        return ResolvedSource(
          input: originInput,
          normalizedUri: currentUri,
          finalUri: finalUri,
          kind: byResponse,
          playbackMode: PlaybackMode.native,
          discoveryMethod: DiscoveryMethod.htmlVideo,
          capability: SourceCapability.full,
          redirectChain: redirectChain,
          iframeChain: iframeChain,
          candidates: [candidate],
          selectedCandidate: candidate,
          resolutionDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,
          diagnostics: diagnostics,
          requestContext: requestContext,
        );
      }

      if (body.isEmpty) {
        throw const ResolutionException('Empty response or non-HTML content.');
      }

      // Step 3: Static HTML inspection
      final parsed = _parser.parse(body, finalUri);
      final verifiedCandidates = <MediaCandidate>[];

      if (parsed.candidates.isNotEmpty) {
        final sorted = [...parsed.candidates]
          ..sort((a, b) => b.score.compareTo(a.score));
        for (final candidate in sorted) {
          final verification = await _verifier.verify(candidate, headers: requestContext.headers);
          verifiedCandidates.add(verification.candidate);
          if (verification.isAccessible) {
            diagnostics.add(
              'Static HTML candidate verified accessible score=${verification.candidate.score} status=${verification.statusCode}',
            );
            return ResolvedSource(
              input: originInput,
              normalizedUri: currentUri,
              finalUri: verification.candidate.uri,
              kind: verification.candidate.kind,
              playbackMode: PlaybackMode.native,
              discoveryMethod: candidate.method,
              capability: SourceCapability.full,
              redirectChain: redirectChain,
              iframeChain: iframeChain,
              candidates: verifiedCandidates,
              selectedCandidate: verification.candidate,
              resolutionDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,
              diagnostics: diagnostics,
              requestContext: requestContext,
            );
          } else {
            rejectionReasons[candidate.uri.toString()] =
                verification.error ?? 'HTTP ${verification.statusCode}';
          }
        }
      }

      // Step 4 & 5: Iframe discovery & recursion
      for (final iframe in parsed.iframes) {
        try {
          return await _resolveInternal(
            iframe,
            originInput: originInput,
            depth: depth + 1,
            visited: visited,
            redirectChain: redirectChain,
            iframeChain: [...iframeChain, iframe],
            diagnostics: diagnostics,
            rejectionReasons: rejectionReasons,
            stopwatch: stopwatch,
            cancelToken: cancelToken,
            requestContext: requestContext,
          );
        } on ResolutionException {
          // Continue to next iframe
        } catch (e) {
          // Continue to next iframe
        }
      }

      // Step 6: Fallback to Embedded WebView runtime observation mode
      final embeddedUri = parsed.iframes.isNotEmpty
          ? parsed.iframes.first
          : finalUri;
      diagnostics.add('No static accessible media candidate verified.');
      diagnostics.add(
        'Opened in embedded WebView fallback. Android runtime media observer active.',
      );

      return ResolvedSource(
        input: originInput,
        normalizedUri: currentUri,
        finalUri: embeddedUri,
        kind: MediaKind.embedded,
        playbackMode: PlaybackMode.embedded,
        discoveryMethod: parsed.iframes.isEmpty
            ? DiscoveryMethod.runtime
            : DiscoveryMethod.iframe,
        capability: SourceCapability.embedded,
        redirectChain: redirectChain,
        iframeChain: [
          ...iframeChain,
          if (parsed.iframes.isNotEmpty) embeddedUri,
        ],
        candidates: verifiedCandidates,
        resolutionDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,
        rejectionReasons: rejectionReasons,
        diagnostics: diagnostics,
        requestContext: requestContext,
      );
    } on DioException catch (error) {
      if (CancelToken.isCancel(error)) rethrow;
      throw ResolutionException('Could not load source page.', error);
    }
  }

  Future<({Uri finalUri, String contentType, String body})> _probe(
    Uri uri,
    CancelToken cancelToken,
    RequestContext requestContext,
  ) async {
    final response = await _dio.get<ResponseBody>(
      uri.toString(),
      options: Options(
        responseType: ResponseType.stream,
        headers: requestContext.headers,
      ),
      cancelToken: cancelToken,
    );

    final contentType =
        response.headers.value(Headers.contentTypeHeader)?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
    final finalUri = response.realUri;

    // Check if it's likely a direct media stream
    final isMedia = contentType.startsWith('video/') ||
        contentType.contains('mpegurl') ||
        contentType.contains('dash+xml') ||
        contentType.contains('application/octet-stream');

    final isManifest = contentType.contains('mpegurl') || contentType.contains('dash+xml');

    if (isMedia && !isManifest) {
      // It's a video file, don't read body to avoid OOM
      return (finalUri: finalUri, contentType: contentType, body: '');
    }

    // Read limited body for HTML/Manifest parsing
    final builder = BytesBuilder(copy: false);
    int totalRead = 0;

    try {
      await for (final chunk in response.data!.stream) {
        builder.add(chunk);
        totalRead += chunk.length;
        if (totalRead >= _kMaxProbeBytes) {
          break;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Partial read is better than nothing for probing
    }

    final bodyBytes = builder.takeBytes();
    final body = utf8.decode(bodyBytes, allowMalformed: true);

    return (
      finalUri: finalUri,
      contentType: contentType,
      body: body,
    );
  }


  MediaKind? _detectResponse(Uri uri, String contentType, String body) {
    final pathKind = _toMediaKind(MediaUrl.classify(uri.toString()));
    if (pathKind != null) {
      return pathKind;
    }
    final trimmedBody = body.trimLeft();
    if (contentType.contains('mpegurl') || trimmedBody.startsWith('#EXTM3U')) {
      return MediaKind.hls;
    }
    if (contentType.contains('dash+xml') ||
        trimmedBody.startsWith('<MPD') ||
        trimmedBody.contains('xmlns="urn:mpeg:dash:schema:mpd:2011"')) {
      return MediaKind.dash;
    }
    if (contentType.startsWith('video/')) {
      return MediaKind.progressive;
    }
    return null;
  }

  MediaKind? _toMediaKind(MediaUrlKind kind) => switch (kind) {
    MediaUrlKind.hls => MediaKind.hls,
    MediaUrlKind.dash => MediaKind.dash,
    MediaUrlKind.progressive => MediaKind.progressive,
    _ => null,
  };
}

import '../../data/media_candidate.dart';

enum PlaybackMode { native, embedded }

enum MediaKind { hls, dash, progressive, localFile, embedded }

enum DiscoveryMethod { input, htmlVideo, iframe, runtime, localFile }

class SourceCapability {
  const SourceCapability({
    required this.nativePlayback,
    required this.embeddedPlayback,
    required this.seek,
    this.duration,
    required this.positionReadable,
    required this.pauseControllable,
    required this.seekControllable,
    required this.audioAccessible,
    required this.subtitleTracksAccessible,
    required this.aiLookahead,
    required this.dubbingPotential,
  });

  final bool nativePlayback;
  final bool embeddedPlayback;
  final bool seek;
  final Duration? duration;
  final bool positionReadable;
  final bool pauseControllable;
  final bool seekControllable;
  final bool audioAccessible;
  final bool subtitleTracksAccessible;
  final bool aiLookahead;
  final bool dubbingPotential;

  static const full = SourceCapability(
    nativePlayback: true,
    embeddedPlayback: true,
    seek: true,
    positionReadable: true,
    pauseControllable: true,
    seekControllable: true,
    audioAccessible: true,
    subtitleTracksAccessible: true,
    aiLookahead: true,
    dubbingPotential: true,
  );

  static const embedded = SourceCapability(
    nativePlayback: false,
    embeddedPlayback: true,
    seek: false,
    positionReadable: false,
    pauseControllable: true,
    seekControllable: false,
    audioAccessible: false,
    subtitleTracksAccessible: false,
    aiLookahead: false,
    dubbingPotential: false,
  );
}

class RequestContext {
  const RequestContext({
    required this.userAgent,
    this.referer,
    this.origin,
    this.headers = const {},
    this.cookies,
  });

  final String userAgent;
  final String? referer;
  final String? origin;
  final Map<String, String> headers;
  final String? cookies;

  static const defaultContext = RequestContext(
    userAgent: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13) LocalAIVideoTranslator/1.0',
  );
}

class ResolvedSource {
  const ResolvedSource({
    required this.input,
    required this.normalizedUri,
    required this.finalUri,
    required this.kind,
    required this.playbackMode,
    required this.discoveryMethod,
    required this.capability,
    this.requestContext = RequestContext.defaultContext,
    this.redirectChain = const [],
    this.iframeChain = const [],
    this.candidates = const [],
    this.selectedCandidate,
    this.resolutionDuration = Duration.zero,
    this.failureReason,
    this.rejectionReasons = const {},
    this.diagnostics = const [],
    this.manualSubtitlePath,
  });

  final String input;
  final Uri normalizedUri;
  final Uri finalUri;
  final MediaKind kind;
  final PlaybackMode playbackMode;
  final DiscoveryMethod discoveryMethod;
  final SourceCapability capability;
  final RequestContext requestContext;
  final List<Uri> redirectChain;
  final List<Uri> iframeChain;
  final List<MediaCandidate> candidates;
  final MediaCandidate? selectedCandidate;
  final Duration resolutionDuration;
  final String? failureReason;
  final Map<String, String> rejectionReasons;
  final List<String> diagnostics;
  final String? manualSubtitlePath;

  Uri get uri => finalUri;
  Map<String, String> get headers => requestContext.headers;
  bool get supportsFullAi =>
      capability.audioAccessible && capability.positionReadable;

  ResolvedSource copyWith({
    String? input,
    Uri? normalizedUri,
    Uri? finalUri,
    MediaKind? kind,
    PlaybackMode? playbackMode,
    DiscoveryMethod? discoveryMethod,
    SourceCapability? capability,
    RequestContext? requestContext,
    List<Uri>? redirectChain,
    List<Uri>? iframeChain,
    List<MediaCandidate>? candidates,
    MediaCandidate? selectedCandidate,
    Duration? resolutionDuration,
    String? failureReason,
    Map<String, String>? rejectionReasons,
    List<String>? diagnostics,
    String? manualSubtitlePath,
  }) {
    return ResolvedSource(
      input: input ?? this.input,
      normalizedUri: normalizedUri ?? this.normalizedUri,
      finalUri: finalUri ?? this.finalUri,
      kind: kind ?? this.kind,
      playbackMode: playbackMode ?? this.playbackMode,
      discoveryMethod: discoveryMethod ?? this.discoveryMethod,
      capability: capability ?? this.capability,
      requestContext: requestContext ?? this.requestContext,
      redirectChain: redirectChain ?? this.redirectChain,
      iframeChain: iframeChain ?? this.iframeChain,
      candidates: candidates ?? this.candidates,
      selectedCandidate: selectedCandidate ?? this.selectedCandidate,
      resolutionDuration: resolutionDuration ?? this.resolutionDuration,
      failureReason: failureReason ?? this.failureReason,
      rejectionReasons: rejectionReasons ?? this.rejectionReasons,
      diagnostics: diagnostics ?? this.diagnostics,
      manualSubtitlePath: manualSubtitlePath ?? this.manualSubtitlePath,
    );
  }
}
