## lib/core/diagnostics/diagnostics_exporter.dart
```dart:lib/core/diagnostics/diagnostics_exporter.dart
class DiagnosticsExporter {
  const DiagnosticsExporter();

  /// Exports local diagnostics report with sensitive values (cookies, auth headers, tokens) strictly redacted.
  String exportRedactedReport({
    required String sourceUri,
    required Map<String, String> headers,
    required List<String> logEvents,
  }) {
    final sanitizedUri = _redactUriTokens(sourceUri);
    final sanitizedHeaders = _redactHeaders(headers);
    final sanitizedLogs = logEvents.map(_redactLogMessage).toList();

    return '''
=== LOCAL AI VIDEO TRANSLATOR DIAGNOSTICS EXPORT ===
Source URI: $sanitizedUri
Headers: $sanitizedHeaders
-----------------------------------------------------
Logs:
${sanitizedLogs.join('\n')}
=====================================================
''';
  }

  String _redactUriTokens(String uriStr) {
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse(uriStr);
      final queryParams = Map<String, String>.from(uri.queryParameters);
      for (final key in queryParams.keys) {
        if (key.toLowerCase().contains('token') ||
            key.toLowerCase().contains('auth') ||
            key.toLowerCase().contains('sig') ||
            key.toLowerCase().contains('key')) {
          queryParams[key] = '[REDACTED]';
        }
      }
      return uri
          .replace(queryParameters: queryParams.isNotEmpty ? queryParams : null)
          .toString();
    } catch (_) {
      return '[REDACTED_URI]';
    }
  }

  Map<String, String> _redactHeaders(Map<String, String> headers) {
    final redacted = <String, String>{};
    for (final entry in headers.entries) {
      final keyLower = entry.key.toLowerCase();
      if (keyLower.contains('authorization') ||
          keyLower.contains('cookie') ||
          keyLower.contains('token') ||
          keyLower.contains('api-key')) {
        redacted[entry.key] = '[REDACTED]';
      } else {
        redacted[entry.key] = entry.value;
      }
    }
    return redacted;
  }

  String _redactLogMessage(String message) {
    // Redact potential tokens or passwords in log lines
    var sanitized = message.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'token=[^&\s]+', caseSensitive: false),
      'token=[REDACTED]',
    );
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'authorization:[^\s]+', caseSensitive: false),
      'authorization:[REDACTED]',
    );
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'key=[^&\s]+', caseSensitive: false),
      'key=[REDACTED]',
    );
    return sanitized;
  }
}

## lib/core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart
```dart:lib/core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

enum LogLevel { debug, info, warning, error }

class DiagnosticEntry {
  const DiagnosticEntry({
    required this.timestamp,
    required this.subsystem,
    required this.message,
    required this.level,
    this.details,
  });

  final DateTime timestamp;
  final String subsystem;
  final String message;
  final LogLevel level;
  final Object? details;

  @override
  String toString() {
    final timeStr = timestamp.toIso8601String().substring(11, 19);
    final detailStr = details != null ? ' | $details' : '';
    return '[$timeStr] [${level.name.toUpperCase()}] [$subsystem] $message$detailStr';
  }
}

class DiagnosticsService {
  final _logs = <DiagnosticEntry>[];
  final _controller = StreamController<DiagnosticEntry>.broadcast();

  List<DiagnosticEntry> get logs => List.unmodifiable(_logs);
  Stream<DiagnosticEntry> get stream => _controller.stream;

  void log(
    String subsystem,
    String message, {
    LogLevel level = LogLevel.info,
    Object? details,
  }) {
    final entry = DiagnosticEntry(
      timestamp: DateTime.now(),
      subsystem: subsystem,
      message: message,
      level: level,
      details: details,
    );
    _logs.add(entry);
    if (_logs.length > 500) {
      _logs.removeAt(0);
    }
    _controller.add(entry);
  }

  void clear() {
    _logs.clear();
  }

  void dispose() {
    _controller.close();
  }
}

final diagnosticsServiceProvider = Provider<DiagnosticsService>((ref) {
  final service = DiagnosticsService();
  ref.onDispose(service.dispose);
  return service;
});

                  itemCount: logs.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const Divider(color: Colors.white10, height: 1),

                    final entry = logs[index];
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                      child: SelectableText(
                        entry.toString(),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: _getColor(entry.level),
                          fontSize: 11,
                          fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _getColor(LogLevel level) {
    switch (level) {
      case LogLevel.error: return Colors.redAccent;
      case LogLevel.warning: return Colors.orangeAccent;
      case LogLevel.debug: return Colors.grey;
      case LogLevel.info: return Colors.white70;
    }
  }

```dart:lib/core/errors/error_ux_handler.dart
enum AppErrorType {
  invalidUrl,
  unsupportedMedia,
  networkFailure,
  sourceGone,
  codecUnsupported,
  modelMissing,
  modelCorrupted,
  aiOom,
  aiTooSlow,
  embeddedAudioUnavailable,
  permissionDenied,
  translationError,
  storageFull,
  unknown,
}

class UserFriendlyError {
  const UserFriendlyError({
    required this.type,
    required this.title,
    required this.message,
    required this.actionLabel,
  });

  final AppErrorType type;
  final String title;
  final String message;
  final String actionLabel;

  static UserFriendlyError handle(Object error) {
    final str = error.toString().toLowerCase();

    if (str.contains('url') || str.contains('invalid')) {
      return const UserFriendlyError(
        type: AppErrorType.invalidUrl,
        title: 'Invalid URL',
        message:
            'The provided media link is invalid or malformed. Please check and try again.',
        actionLabel: 'Edit URL',
      );
    }
    if (str.contains('codec') || str.contains('unsupported')) {
      return const UserFriendlyError(
        type: AppErrorType.codecUnsupported,
        title: 'Codec Unsupported',
        message:
            'The media format or codec is not supported by the playback backend.',
        actionLabel: 'Switch Mode',
      );
    }
    if (str.contains('network') ||
        str.contains('socket') ||
        str.contains('dioexception')) {
      return const UserFriendlyError(
        type: AppErrorType.networkFailure,
        title: 'Network Connection Error',
        message:
            'Unable to connect to media source. Please check your internet connection.',
        actionLabel: 'Retry Connection',
      );
    }
    if (str.contains('model') &&
        (str.contains('missing') || str.contains('not found'))) {
      return const UserFriendlyError(
        type: AppErrorType.modelMissing,
        title: 'AI Model Required',
        message:
            'Required local AI models are not downloaded. Please download them in Settings.',
        actionLabel: 'Open Model Manager',
      );
    }
    if (str.contains('storage') || str.contains('space')) {
      return const UserFriendlyError(
        type: AppErrorType.storageFull,
        title: 'Storage Full',
        message:
            'Device storage is nearly full. Please clear cache or free up space.',
        actionLabel: 'Clear Cache',
      );
    }
    if (str.contains('permission') || str.contains('denied')) {
      return const UserFriendlyError(
        type: AppErrorType.permissionDenied,
        title: 'Permission Denied',
        message:
            'Required audio capture permission was denied. AI subtitles will remain disabled.',
        actionLabel: 'Open Settings',
      );
    }

    return const UserFriendlyError(
      type: AppErrorType.unknown,
      title: 'Playback Error',
      message: 'An unexpected error occurred during playback or AI processing.',
      actionLabel: 'Retry',
    );
  }
}

## lib/core/utils/media_url.dart
```dart:lib/core/utils/media_url.dart
enum MediaUrlKind { hls, dash, progressive, webPage, localFile, unknown }

abstract final class MediaUrl {
  static MediaUrlKind classify(String input) {
    final value = input.trim();
    if (value.startsWith('file://') ||
        value.startsWith('content://') ||
        value.startsWith('/')) {
      return MediaUrlKind.localFile;
    }
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(value);
    if (uri == null || !uri.hasScheme) {
      return MediaUrlKind.unknown;
    }
    final path = uri.path.toLowerCase();
    if (path.endsWith('.m3u8')) {
      return MediaUrlKind.hls;
    }
    if (path.endsWith('.mpd')) {
      return MediaUrlKind.dash;
    }
    if (['.mp4', '.mkv', '.webm', '.mov', '.m4v'].any(path.endsWith)) {
      return MediaUrlKind.progressive;
    }
    if (uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'https') {
      return MediaUrlKind.webPage;
    }
    return MediaUrlKind.unknown;
  }
}

abstract final class Sha256Util {
  static Future<String> computeFileHash(File file) async {
    if (!await file.exists()) return '';
    final stream = file.openRead();
    final digest = await sha256.bind(stream).first;
    return digest.toString();
  }

  static String computeBytesHash(List<int> bytes) {
    return sha256.convert(bytes).toString();
  }
}

## lib/core/utils/shared_input_parser.dart
```dart:lib/core/utils/shared_input_parser.dart
/// Extracts http(s) URLs or valid file paths from shared content.
abstract final class SharedInputParser {
  static final RegExp _urlPattern = RegExp(
    r'''https?://[^\s<>"']+''',
    caseSensitive: false,
  );

  /// Returns the first usable source, or null if none found.
  static String? extract(String raw) {
    final text = raw.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return null;

    // 1. Check for URLs embedded in text ("Check this out https://...")
    final match = _urlPattern.firstMatch(text);
    if (match != null) {
      // Clean up common trailing punctuation from sharing apps
      return match.group(0)!.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'[)\].,;!?]+$'), '');
    }

    // 2. Local file or content provider path
    if (text.startsWith('/') || text.startsWith('content://') || text.startsWith('file://')) {
      return text;
    }

    // 3. Fallback for raw domains (e.g. "youtube.com/watch...")
    if (text.contains('.') && !text.contains(' ')) {
       return text.startsWith('http') ? text : 'https://$text';
    }

    return null;
  }
}

## lib/core/utils/tokenizer.dart
```dart:lib/core/utils/tokenizer.dart
import 'dart:convert';

/// A simplified BPE/WordPiece tokenizer for local ONNX models.
class SimpleTokenizer {
  SimpleTokenizer._(this._vocab, this._specialTokens);

  final Map<String, int> _vocab;
  final Map<String, int> _specialTokens;
  final Map<int, String> _invVocab = {};

  static Future<SimpleTokenizer> load(String vocabJson) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = jsonDecode(vocabJson);
    final vocab = <String, int>{};
    final special = <String, int>{};

    data.forEach((key, value) {
      // Nhận diện các định dạng token đặc biệt phổ biến: <|...|>, [CLS], </s>, >>lang<<, etc.
      final isSpecial = (key.startsWith('<|') && key.endsWith('|>')) ||
          (key.startsWith('[') && key.endsWith(']')) ||
          (key.startsWith('>>') && key.endsWith('<<')) ||
          (key.startsWith('<') && key.endsWith('>') && key.length <= 6) ||
          key == '</s>' ||
          key == '<mask>';

      if (isSpecial) {
        special[key] = value;
      }
      vocab[key] = value;
    });

    final tokenizer = SimpleTokenizer._(vocab, special);
    vocab.forEach((key, value) {
      tokenizer._invVocab[value] = key;
    });
    return tokenizer;
  }

  /// Encodes text using greedy longest-match (essential for BPE/SentencePiece).
  List<int> encode(String text, {bool addWhisperTokens = false, String? lang}) {
    final tokens = <int>[];

    // Prepend Whisper special tokens if required
    if (addWhisperTokens) {
      tokens.add(_specialTokens['<|startoftranscript|>'] ?? 50257);
      if (lang == 'vi') tokens.add(_specialTokens['<|vi|>'] ?? 50275);
      tokens.add(_specialTokens['<|transcribe|>'] ?? 50359);
      tokens.add(_specialTokens['<|notimestamps|>'] ?? 50362);
    }

    // Normalizing space to the special meta-character ' ' (U+2581)
    final normalized = text.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', ' ');
    int start = 0;
    while (start < normalized.length) {
      bool found = false;
      for (int end = normalized.length; end > start; end--) {
        final sub = normalized.substring(start, end);
        if (_vocab.containsKey(sub)) {
          tokens.add(_vocab[sub]!);
          start = end;
          found = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!found) {
        final char = normalized[start];
        tokens.add(_vocab[char] ?? _specialTokens['<|unk|>'] ?? 3);
        start++;
      }
    }

    if (addWhisperTokens) {
      tokens.add(_specialTokens['<|endoftranscript|>'] ?? 50256);
    }
    return tokens;
  }

  String decode(List<int> tokens) {
    return tokens
        .map((t) => _invVocab[t] ?? '')
        .where((s) => !s.startsWith('<|')) // Filter special tokens
        .join('')
        .replaceAll(' ', ' ')
        .trim();
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

class AudioMetrics {
  const AudioMetrics({
    this.queueSize = 0,
    this.queuedAudioSeconds = 0.0,
    this.vadRealtimeFactor = 1.0,
    this.speechPercentage = 0.0,
    this.memoryConsumptionBytes = 0,
  });

  final int queueSize;
  final double queuedAudioSeconds;
  final double vadRealtimeFactor;
  final double speechPercentage;
  final int memoryConsumptionBytes;

  AudioMetrics copyWith({
    int? queueSize,
    double? queuedAudioSeconds,
    double? vadRealtimeFactor,
    double? speechPercentage,
    int? memoryConsumptionBytes,
  }) {
    return AudioMetrics(
      queueSize: queueSize ?? this.queueSize,
      queuedAudioSeconds: queuedAudioSeconds ?? this.queuedAudioSeconds,
      vadRealtimeFactor: vadRealtimeFactor ?? this.vadRealtimeFactor,
      speechPercentage: speechPercentage ?? this.speechPercentage,
      memoryConsumptionBytes:
          memoryConsumptionBytes ?? this.memoryConsumptionBytes,
    );
  }
}

class AudioDiagnostics {
  AudioMetrics _metrics = const AudioMetrics();
  final _controller = StreamController<AudioMetrics>.broadcast();

  AudioMetrics get metrics => _metrics;
  Stream<AudioMetrics> get stream => _controller.stream;

  void updateMetrics(AudioMetrics newMetrics) {
    _metrics = newMetrics;
    if (!_controller.isClosed) {
      _controller.add(_metrics);
    }
  }

  void reset() {
    _metrics = const AudioMetrics();
    if (!_controller.isClosed) {
      _controller.add(_metrics);
    }
  }

  void dispose() {
    _controller.close();
  }
}

```dart:lib/features/audio/data/bounded_pcm_queue.dart
import 'dart:collection';
import '../../pipeline/domain/ai_pipeline.dart';

class BoundedPcmQueue {
  BoundedPcmQueue({this.maxCapacity = 100});

  final int maxCapacity;
  final Queue<PcmChunk> _queue = Queue<PcmChunk>();

  int get length => _queue.length;
  bool get isEmpty => _queue.isEmpty;
  bool get isFull => _queue.length >= maxCapacity;

  void enqueue(PcmChunk chunk) {
    if (isFull) {
      // Drop oldest chunk to apply backpressure & prevent unlimited memory accumulation
      _queue.removeFirst();
    }
    _queue.add(chunk);
  }

  PcmChunk? dequeue() {
    if (_queue.isEmpty) return null;
    return _queue.removeFirst();
  }

  void clearBefore(Duration pts) {
    _queue.removeWhere(
      (chunk) => chunk.pts + const Duration(milliseconds: 500) < pts,
    );
  }

  void clear() {
    _queue.clear();
  }

  Duration get queuedAudioDuration {
    if (_queue.isEmpty) return Duration.zero;
    final first = _queue.first.pts;
    final last = _queue.last.pts + const Duration(milliseconds: 500);
    return last > first ? last - first : Duration.zero;
  }

  int get approximateMemoryBytes {
    int total = 0;
    for (final chunk in _queue) {
      total += chunk.bytes.length;
    }
    return total;
  }
}

## lib/features/audio/data/ffmpeg_audio_extractor.dart
```dart:lib/features/audio/data/ffmpeg_audio_extractor.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:ffmpeg_kit_flutter_new/ffmpeg_kit.dart';
import 'package:ffmpeg_kit_flutter_new/ffmpeg_kit_config.dart';
import 'package:ffmpeg_kit_flutter_new/return_code.dart';

import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../../pipeline/domain/ai_pipeline.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import 'pcm_audio_extractor.dart';

class FfmpegPcmAudioExtractor implements PcmAudioExtractor {
  FfmpegPcmAudioExtractor(this._diagnostics);

  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;

  @override
  bool get isAvailable => true;

  @override
  Stream<PcmChunk> extractPcmStream(
    ResolvedSource source, {
    Duration? startPosition,
  }) async* {
    final pipePath = await FFmpegKitConfig.registerNewFFmpegPipe();
    if (pipePath == null) {
      _diagnostics.log(
        'FFmpegAudio',
        'Could not register FFmpeg pipe',
        level: LogLevel.error,
      );
      return;
    }

    const sampleRate = 16000;
    const channels = 1;
    const chunkDurationMs = 500;
    const bytesPerSecond = sampleRate * channels * 2;
    const bytesPerChunk = (bytesPerSecond * chunkDurationMs) ~/ 1000;

    _diagnostics.log('FFmpegAudio', 'Starting extraction: ${source.uri}');

    final startMs = startPosition?.inMilliseconds ?? 0;
    final ssArg = startMs > 0 ? '-ss ${startMs / 1000.0}' : '';

    String headersArg = '';
    if (source.requestContext.headers.isNotEmpty) {
      final headersString = source.requestContext.headers.entries
          .map((e) => '${e.key}: ${e.value}')
          .join('\r\n');
      headersArg = '-headers "$headersString"';
    }

    final inputPath = source.uri.isScheme('file')
        ? source.uri.toFilePath()
        : source.uri.toString();

    // Thêm rw_timeout 5000000 (5 giây) để tránh đơ mạng
    final ffmpegCommand =
        '-y -nostdin -hide_banner '
        '-rw_timeout 5000000 '
        '$headersArg $ssArg -i "$inputPath" -vn -ac $channels -ar $sampleRate -f s16le "$pipePath"';

    _diagnostics.log('FFmpegAudio', 'FFmpeg Command: $ffmpegCommand');

    final file = File(pipePath);

    final sessionFuture = FFmpegKit.executeAsync(ffmpegCommand, (
      session,
    ) async {
      final returnCode = await session.getReturnCode();
      final logs = await session.getLogs();
      final fullLog = logs.map((l) => l.getMessage()).join('\n');

      if (ReturnCode.isSuccess(returnCode)) {
        _diagnostics.log('FFmpegAudio', 'FFmpeg finished successfully');
      } else {
        _diagnostics.log(
          'FFmpegAudio',
          'FFmpeg Failed (code $returnCode). Log:\n$fullLog',
          level: LogLevel.error,
        );
      }
    });

    final session = await sessionFuture;

    try {
      int retry = 0;
      while (!await file.exists() && retry < 30) {
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));
        retry++;
      }

      if (!await file.exists()) {
        _diagnostics.log(
          'FFmpegAudio',
          'Pipe file not found: $pipePath',
          level: LogLevel.error,
        );
        return;
      }

      _diagnostics.log('FFmpegAudio', 'Pipe ready, opening stream...');
      final inputStream = file.openRead();
      var currentPts = startPosition ?? Duration.zero;
      List<int> pendingBuffer = [];
      int totalBytesRead = 0;

      await for (final data in inputStream.timeout(
        const Duration(seconds: 5),
        onTimeout: (sink) {
          _diagnostics.log(
            'FFmpegAudio',
            'Pipe stream timeout',
            level: LogLevel.warning,
          );
          sink.close();
        },
      )) {
        totalBytesRead += data.length;
        pendingBuffer.addAll(data);

        while (pendingBuffer.length >= bytesPerChunk) {
          final chunkData = pendingBuffer.sublist(0, bytesPerChunk);
          pendingBuffer = pendingBuffer.sublist(bytesPerChunk);

          yield PcmChunk(
            pts: currentPts,
            sampleRate: sampleRate,
            channels: channels,
            bytes: Uint8List.fromList(chunkData),
          );

          currentPts += const Duration(milliseconds: chunkDurationMs);
        }
      }

      _diagnostics.log(
        'FFmpegAudio',
        'Stream closed. Total bytes: $totalBytesRead',
      );

      if (pendingBuffer.isNotEmpty) {
        yield PcmChunk(
          pts: currentPts,
          sampleRate: sampleRate,
          channels: channels,
          bytes: Uint8List.fromList(pendingBuffer),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _diagnostics.log(
        'FFmpegAudio',
        'Stream read error: $e',
        level: LogLevel.error,
      );
    } finally {
      // Hủy tiến trình FFmpeg Native C++ ngay khi dừng
      await FFmpegKit.cancel(session.getSessionId());
      _diagnostics.log(
        'FFmpegAudio',
        'Cleaned up FFmpeg session ${session.getSessionId()}',
      );
    }
  }
}

## lib/features/audio/data/pcm_audio_extractor.dart
```dart:lib/features/audio/data/pcm_audio_extractor.dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../../pipeline/domain/ai_pipeline.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import 'ffmpeg_audio_extractor.dart';

abstract interface class PcmAudioExtractor {
  bool get isAvailable;
  Stream<PcmChunk> extractPcmStream(
    ResolvedSource source, {
    Duration? startPosition,
  });
}

class NativePcmAudioExtractor implements PcmAudioExtractor {
  NativePcmAudioExtractor(this._diagnostics);

  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;
  static const _methodChannel = MethodChannel('local_ai_video_translator/native_resolver');
  static const _eventChannel = EventChannel('local_ai_video_translator/audio_pcm');

  @override
  bool get isAvailable => true;

  @override
  Stream<PcmChunk> extractPcmStream(
    ResolvedSource source, {
    Duration? startPosition,
  }) async* {
    // Chỉ yêu cầu MediaProjection (Share Screen) nếu là nguồn nhúng (Webview)
    // Nguồn local hoặc direct stream thì không cần.
    final needsMediaProjection = source.kind == MediaKind.embedded ||
                                source.playbackMode == PlaybackMode.embedded;

    if (needsMediaProjection) {
      _diagnostics.log('NativeAudio', 'Requesting MediaProjection for embedded source');
      final started = await _methodChannel.invokeMethod<bool>('startAudioCapture');
      if (started != true) {
        _diagnostics.log('NativeAudio', 'MediaProjection denied or failed', level: LogLevel.error);
        throw Exception('Could not start native audio capture for web source');
      }
    }

    final controller = StreamController<PcmChunk>();

    if (!needsMediaProjection) {
      _diagnostics.log('NativeAudio', 'Local/Direct source detected. Using FFmpeg for extraction.');
      // Use FFmpeg for local files or direct streams
      yield* FfmpegPcmAudioExtractor(_diagnostics).extractPcmStream(
        source,
        startPosition: startPosition,
      );
      return;
    }

    // 2. Listen to audio chunks from EventChannel (dành cho MediaProjection)
    int? firstTimestamp;

    final subscription = _eventChannel.receiveBroadcastStream().listen((event) {
      if (event is Map && event['type'] == 'audio_chunk') {
        final data = event['data'] as Uint8List;
        final sampleRate = event['sampleRate'] as int;
        final channels = event['channels'] as int;
        final timestamp = event['timestamp'] as int;

        // Calculate PTS based on native timestamp comparison
        firstTimestamp ??= timestamp;
        final elapsedMs = timestamp - firstTimestamp!;
        final currentPts = (startPosition ?? Duration.zero) + Duration(milliseconds: elapsedMs);

        controller.add(PcmChunk(
          pts: currentPts,
          sampleRate: sampleRate,
          channels: channels,
          bytes: data,
        ));
      }
    });

    try {
      yield* controller.stream;
    } finally {
      await subscription.cancel();
      await _methodChannel.invokeMethod('stopAudioCapture');
      await controller.close();
    }
  }
}

class DefaultPcmAudioExtractor implements PcmAudioExtractor {
  const DefaultPcmAudioExtractor();

  @override
  bool get isAvailable => true;

  @override
  Stream<PcmChunk> extractPcmStream(
    ResolvedSource source, {
    Duration? startPosition,
  }) async* {
    // Media PTS audio stream generator
    // Generates 16kHz mono PCM chunks annotated with media Presentation Timestamps (PTS)
    const sampleRate = 16000;
    const channels = 1;
    const chunkDurationMs = 500; // 500ms chunks
    const samplesPerChunk = (sampleRate * chunkDurationMs) ~/ 1000;
    const bytesPerSample = 2; // 16-bit PCM
    const chunkByteLength = samplesPerChunk * bytesPerSample * channels;

    var currentPts = startPosition ?? Duration.zero;

    // Simulated/Real media stream reader generating PCM audio data bound to PTS
    for (var i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
      final pcmBytes = Uint8List(chunkByteLength);
      yield PcmChunk(
        pts: currentPts,
        sampleRate: sampleRate,
        channels: channels,
        bytes: pcmBytes,
      );
      currentPts += const Duration(milliseconds: chunkDurationMs);
    }
  }
}

## lib/features/audio/data/vad_engine.dart
```dart:lib/features/audio/data/vad_engine.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter_onnxruntime/flutter_onnxruntime.dart';

import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../../pipeline/domain/ai_pipeline.dart';
import '../../settings/data/model_manager_repository.dart';

class SpeechSegment {
  const SpeechSegment({
    required this.start,
    required this.end,
    required this.chunks,
    this.speechRatio = 1.0,
  });

  final Duration start;
  final Duration end;
  final List<PcmChunk> chunks;
  final double speechRatio;
}

abstract interface class VoiceActivityDetector {
  bool get installed;
  Stream<SpeechSegment> detectSpeech(
    Stream<PcmChunk> audioStream, {
    void Function(Duration pts)? onProgress,
  });
}

class LocalVadEngine implements VoiceActivityDetector {
  LocalVadEngine(
    this._modelRepository,
    this._diagnostics, {
    this.threshold = 0.5,
    this.minSpeechDuration = const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
    this.maxMergeGap = const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
    this.preRollDuration = const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
  });

  final ModelManagerRepository _modelRepository;
  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;
  final double threshold;
  final Duration minSpeechDuration;
  final Duration maxMergeGap;
  final Duration preRollDuration;

  static const String modelId = 'vad_silero';

  OrtSession? _session;
  final Float32List _state = Float32List(2 * 1 * 128);

  // Tái sử dụng bộ đệm 512 float32 để giảm thiểu Garbage Collection
  final Float32List _windowFloatBuffer = Float32List(512);

  @override
  bool get installed => true;

  Future<void> _ensureInitialized() async {
    if (_session != null) return;

    final modelFile = await _modelRepository.getModelFile(
      modelId,
      'silero_vad.onnx',
    );
    if (!await modelFile.exists()) {
      return;
    }

    final sessionOptions = OrtSessionOptions();
    _session = await OnnxRuntime().createSession(
      modelFile.path,
      options: sessionOptions,
    );
  }

  @override
  Stream<SpeechSegment> detectSpeech(
    Stream<PcmChunk> audioStream, {
    void Function(Duration pts)? onProgress,
  }) async* {
    await _ensureInitialized();
    _resetState();

    final windowBuffer = BytesBuilder();
    const windowSizeBytes = 512 * 2;
    const windowDuration = Duration(milliseconds: 32);

    final List<PcmChunk> preRollBuffer = [];
    _RawSpeechRange? active;
    _RawSpeechRange? pendingGap;

    var windowOffset = Duration.zero;
    var lastBasePts = Duration.zero;

    await for (final chunk in audioStream) {
      if (chunk.pts != lastBasePts) {
        windowOffset = Duration.zero;
        lastBasePts = chunk.pts;
      }

      windowBuffer.add(chunk.bytes);

      while (windowBuffer.length >= windowSizeBytes) {
        final windowBytes = windowBuffer.takeBytes();
        final currentWindowBytes = windowBytes.sublist(0, windowSizeBytes);
        if (windowBytes.length > windowSizeBytes) {
          windowBuffer.add(windowBytes.sublist(windowSizeBytes));
        }

        final currentPts = chunk.pts + windowOffset;
        final currentChunk = PcmChunk(
          pts: currentPts,
          sampleRate: chunk.sampleRate,
          channels: 1,
          bytes: currentWindowBytes,
        );

        if (onProgress != null) {
          onProgress(currentPts + windowDuration);
        }

        final isSpeech = await _isSpeechData(
          currentWindowBytes,
          chunk.sampleRate,
        );
        windowOffset += windowDuration;

        if (isSpeech) {
          active ??= _RawSpeechRange(
            start: preRollBuffer.isNotEmpty
                ? preRollBuffer.first.pts
                : currentPts,
            end: currentPts + windowDuration,
            chunks: [...preRollBuffer],
          );

          if (pendingGap != null) {
            active.chunks.addAll(pendingGap.chunks);
            pendingGap = null;
          }
          active.chunks.add(currentChunk);
          active.end = currentPts + windowDuration;

          preRollBuffer.clear();
        } else {
          if (active != null) {
            pendingGap ??= _RawSpeechRange(
              start: currentPts,
              end: currentPts + windowDuration,
              chunks: [],
            );
            pendingGap.chunks.add(currentChunk);
            pendingGap.end = currentPts + windowDuration;

            if (pendingGap.end - pendingGap.start > maxMergeGap) {
              if (active.end - active.start >= minSpeechDuration) {
                yield SpeechSegment(
                  start: active.start,
                  end: active.end,
                  chunks: List.unmodifiable(active.chunks),
                );
              }
              active = null;
              pendingGap = null;
            }
          } else {
            preRollBuffer.add(currentChunk);
            final totalPreRoll =
                preRollBuffer.length * windowDuration.inMilliseconds;
            if (totalPreRoll > preRollDuration.inMilliseconds) {
              preRollBuffer.removeAt(0);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (active != null && active.end - active.start >= minSpeechDuration) {
      yield SpeechSegment(
        start: active.start,
        end: active.end,
        chunks: List.unmodifiable(active.chunks),
      );
    }
  }

  void _resetState() {
    _state.fillRange(0, _state.length, 0.0);
  }

  Future<bool> _isSpeechData(Uint8List bytes, int sampleRate) async {
    final session = _session;
    if (session == null) return _isSpeechEnergy(bytes);

    try {
      _fillPcm16ToFloat32Buffer(bytes, _windowFloatBuffer);

      final inputOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(_windowFloatBuffer, [
        1,
        _windowFloatBuffer.length,
      ]);
      final srOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(Int64List.fromList([sampleRate]), [
        1,
      ]);
      final stateOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(_state, [2, 1, 128]);

      final inputs = {'input': inputOrt, 'sr': srOrt, 'state': stateOrt};

      final outputs = await session.run(inputs);

      final outputVal = await outputs['output']?.asList();
      final stateVal = await outputs['state']?.asList();

      if (outputVal != null && stateVal != null) {
        final probability = outputVal[0][0] as double;
        _updateState(_state, stateVal as List<List<List<double>>>);

        await inputOrt.dispose();
        await srOrt.dispose();
        await stateOrt.dispose();
        await outputs['output']?.dispose();
        await outputs['state']?.dispose();

        return probability >= threshold;
      }
    } catch (e, st) {
      _diagnostics.log(
        'VAD_ENGINE',
        'Inference error: $e',
        level: LogLevel.error,
        details: st,
      );
    }
    return _isSpeechEnergy(bytes);
  }

  void _fillPcm16ToFloat32Buffer(Uint8List bytes, Float32List targetBuffer) {
    final int16Data = bytes.buffer.asInt16List();
    const double scale = 1.0 / 32768.0;
    final len = min(int16Data.length, targetBuffer.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      targetBuffer[i] = int16Data[i] * scale;
    }
  }

  void _updateState(Float32List state, List<List<List<double>>> newValue) {
    int idx = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < newValue.length; i++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < newValue[i].length; j++) {
        for (var k = 0; k < newValue[i][j].length; k++) {
          state[idx++] = newValue[i][j][k].toDouble();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  bool _isSpeechEnergy(Uint8List bytes) {
    final samples = bytes.buffer.asInt16List();
    double sumSquare = 0;
    for (final s in samples) {
      sumSquare += s * s;
    }
    final energy = sqrt(sumSquare / samples.length);
    return energy >= 250.0;
  }

  void dispose() {
    _session?.close();
    _session = null;
  }
}

class _RawSpeechRange {
  _RawSpeechRange({
    required this.start,
    required this.end,
    required this.chunks,
  });
  final Duration start;
  Duration end;
  final List<PcmChunk> chunks;
}

## lib/features/home/presentation/home_page.dart
```dart:lib/features/home/presentation/home_page.dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:file_picker/file_picker.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:receive_sharing_intent/receive_sharing_intent.dart';

import '../../../app/theme/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../app/theme/app_components.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/presentation/source_resolver_controller.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/shared_input_parser.dart';

class HomePage extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const HomePage({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<HomePage> createState() => _HomePageState();
}

class _HomePageState extends ConsumerState<HomePage> {
  final _controller = TextEditingController();
  StreamSubscription<List<SharedMediaFile>>? _shareSubscription;

  bool _isPickingFile = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _listenToShares();
  }

  void _listenToShares() {
    _shareSubscription = ReceiveSharingIntent.instance.getMediaStream().listen(
      _consumeSharedItems,
    );
    ReceiveSharingIntent.instance.getInitialMedia().then(_consumeSharedItems);
  }

  void _consumeSharedItems(List<SharedMediaFile> items) {
    if (items.isEmpty || !mounted) return;

    final rawPath = items.first.path;
    final value = SharedInputParser.extract(rawPath);

    // Reset so the same intent doesn't trigger again on rebuild
    ReceiveSharingIntent.instance.reset();

    if (value == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Không tìm thấy liên kết video hợp lệ.')),
      );
      return;
    }

    _controller.text = value;
    unawaited(_resolve(value));
  }

  Future<void> _pasteFromClipboard() async {
    final data = await Clipboard.getData(Clipboard.kTextPlain);
    if (data?.text != null && data!.text!.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _controller.text = data.text!;
      });
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('Đã dán liên kết từ bộ nhớ tạm!'),
            duration: Duration(seconds: 1),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openFile() async {
    if (_isPickingFile) return;
    setState(() => _isPickingFile = true);

    try {
      final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.video);
      final path = result?.files.firstOrNull?.path;
      if (path != null) await _resolve(path);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error picking file: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isPickingFile = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickSubtitle() async {
    if (_isPickingFile) return;
    setState(() => _isPickingFile = true);

    try {
      final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: ['srt', 'vtt', 'ass'],
      );
      final path = result?.files.firstOrNull?.path;
      if (path != null && mounted) {
        ref.read(sourceResolverControllerProvider.notifier).setManualSubtitle(path);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Đã chọn phụ đề: ${result?.files.first.name}'),
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error picking subtitle: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isPickingFile = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _resolve(String value) async {
    if (value.trim().isEmpty) return;
    context.push('/analysis', extra: value.trim());
  }

## lib/features/pipeline/data/ai_cache_repository.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/ai_cache_repository.dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';

import '../domain/cache_invalidation.dart';
import '../domain/media_identity.dart';
import '../domain/ai_pipeline.dart';

class AiCachedRecord {
  const AiCachedRecord({
    required this.fingerprint,
    required this.sttVersion,
    required this.translationVersion,
    required this.targetLanguage,
    required this.pipelineVersion,
    required this.segments,
    required this.createdAt,
    required this.sizeBytes,
  });

  final String fingerprint;
  final String sttVersion;
  final String translationVersion;
  final String targetLanguage;
  final String pipelineVersion;
  final List<TimedTextSegment> segments;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final int sizeBytes;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'fingerprint': fingerprint,
    'sttVersion': sttVersion,
    'translationVersion': translationVersion,
    'targetLanguage': targetLanguage,
    'pipelineVersion': pipelineVersion,
    'createdAt': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
    'sizeBytes': sizeBytes,
    'segments': segments
        .map(
          (s) => {
            'startMs': s.start.inMilliseconds,
            'endMs': s.end.inMilliseconds,
            'text': s.text,
            'language': s.language,
          },
        )
        .toList(),
  };

  factory AiCachedRecord.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final rawSegments = (json['segments'] as List<dynamic>?) ?? [];
    final segments = rawSegments
        .map(
          (e) => TimedTextSegment(
            start: Duration(milliseconds: e['startMs'] as int),
            end: Duration(milliseconds: e['endMs'] as int),
            text: e['text'] as String,
            language: e['language'] as String?,
          ),
        )
        .toList();

    return AiCachedRecord(
      fingerprint: json['fingerprint'] as String,
      sttVersion: json['sttVersion'] as String,
      translationVersion: json['translationVersion'] as String,
      targetLanguage: json['targetLanguage'] as String,
      pipelineVersion: json['pipelineVersion'] as String,
      segments: segments,
      createdAt: DateTime.parse(json['createdAt'] as String),
      sizeBytes: json['sizeBytes'] as int,
    );
  }
}

class AiCacheRepository {
  AiCacheRepository({CacheInvalidationPolicy? invalidationPolicy})
    : _invalidationPolicy =
          invalidationPolicy ?? CacheInvalidationPolicy.currentPolicy;

  final CacheInvalidationPolicy _invalidationPolicy;
  final Map<String, AiCachedRecord> _memoryCache = {};

  Future<Directory> get _cacheDir async {
    final docs = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    final dir = Directory('${docs.path}/ai_cache');
    if (!await dir.exists()) {
      await dir.create(recursive: true);
    }
    return dir;
  }

  Future<void> saveRecord({
    required MediaIdentity identity,
    required List<TimedTextSegment> segments,
  }) async {
    final fingerprint = identity.generateFingerprint();
    final jsonStr = jsonEncode({
      'fingerprint': fingerprint,
      'sttVersion': _invalidationPolicy.sttModelVersion,
      'translationVersion': _invalidationPolicy.translationModelVersion,
      'targetLanguage': _invalidationPolicy.targetLanguage,
      'pipelineVersion': _invalidationPolicy.pipelineVersion,
      'createdAt': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      'sizeBytes': segments.fold<int>(0, (sum, s) => sum + s.text.length * 2),
      'segments': segments
          .map(
            (s) => {
              'startMs': s.start.inMilliseconds,
              'endMs': s.end.inMilliseconds,
              'text': s.text,
              'language': s.language,
            },
          )
          .toList(),
    });

    final record = AiCachedRecord(
      fingerprint: fingerprint,
      sttVersion: _invalidationPolicy.sttModelVersion,
      translationVersion: _invalidationPolicy.translationModelVersion,
      targetLanguage: _invalidationPolicy.targetLanguage,
      pipelineVersion: _invalidationPolicy.pipelineVersion,
      segments: segments,
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      sizeBytes: jsonStr.length,
    );

    _memoryCache[fingerprint] = record;

    try {
      final dir = await _cacheDir;
      final file = File('${dir.path}/$fingerprint.json');
      await file.writeAsString(jsonStr);
    } catch (_) {
      // Disk write fallback
    }
  }

  Future<List<TimedTextSegment>?> getRecord(MediaIdentity identity) async {
    final fingerprint = identity.generateFingerprint();

    if (_memoryCache.containsKey(fingerprint)) {
      final rec = _memoryCache[fingerprint]!;
      if (_invalidationPolicy.isCompatible(
        cachedSttVersion: rec.sttVersion,
        cachedTranslationVersion: rec.translationVersion,
        cachedTargetLang: rec.targetLanguage,
        cachedPipelineVersion: rec.pipelineVersion,
      )) {
        return rec.segments;
      }
    }

    try {
      final dir = await _cacheDir;
      final file = File('${dir.path}/$fingerprint.json');
      if (await file.exists()) {
        final content = await file.readAsString();
        final jsonMap = jsonDecode(content) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final rec = AiCachedRecord.fromJson(jsonMap);

        if (_invalidationPolicy.isCompatible(
          cachedSttVersion: rec.sttVersion,
          cachedTranslationVersion: rec.translationVersion,
          cachedTargetLang: rec.targetLanguage,
          cachedPipelineVersion: rec.pipelineVersion,
        )) {
          _memoryCache[fingerprint] = rec;
          return rec.segments;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Disk read fallback
    }

    return null;
  }

  Future<int> getTotalCacheSizeBytes() async {
    int total = 0;
    for (final rec in _memoryCache.values) {
      total += rec.sizeBytes;
    }

    try {
      final dir = await _cacheDir;
      if (await dir.exists()) {
        await for (final entity in dir.list()) {
          if (entity is File) {
            total += await entity.length();
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    return total;
  }

  Future<void> clearMedia(MediaIdentity identity) async {
    final fingerprint = identity.generateFingerprint();
    _memoryCache.remove(fingerprint);

    try {
      final dir = await _cacheDir;
      final file = File('${dir.path}/$fingerprint.json');
      if (await file.exists()) {
        await file.delete();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> clearAll() async {
    _memoryCache.clear();

    try {
      final dir = await _cacheDir;
      if (await dir.exists()) {
        await dir.delete(recursive: true);
        await dir.create(recursive: true);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Bounded storage automatic cleanup policy (LRU / max size enforcement)
  Future<void> enforceBoundedStorage({
    int maxSizeBytes = 100 * 1024 * 1024,
  }) async {
    final currentSize = await getTotalCacheSizeBytes();
    if (currentSize <= maxSizeBytes) return;

    try {
      final dir = await _cacheDir;
      if (await dir.exists()) {
        final files = <File>[];
        await for (final entity in dir.list()) {
          if (entity is File) {
            files.add(entity);
          }
        }

        // Sort by last modified (oldest first for LRU eviction)
        files.sort(
          (a, b) => a.lastModifiedSync().compareTo(b.lastModifiedSync()),
        );

        for (final file in files) {
          await file.delete();
          // Remove from memory cache as well
          final name = file.uri.pathSegments.last;
          final fingerprint = name.replaceAll('.json', '');
          _memoryCache.remove(fingerprint);

          final newSize = await getTotalCacheSizeBytes();
          if (newSize <= maxSizeBytes) break;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/data/dubbing_player_service.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/dubbing_player_service.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:media_kit/media_kit.dart';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import '../domain/dub_segment.dart';
import 'dubbing_repository.dart';

class DubbingPlayerService {
  DubbingPlayerService(this._repository) {
    _player.stream.completed.listen((_) {
      _duckingController.add(false);
      _cleanupTempFile();
    });
  }

  final DubbingRepository _repository;
  final Player _player = Player();
  final _duckingController = StreamController<bool>.broadcast();
  File? _tempWavFile;

  Duration? _lastPlayedStart;

  Stream<bool> get duckingStream => _duckingController.stream;

  void syncWithPlayback(Duration position, bool isVideoPlaying) {
    if (!isVideoPlaying) {
      if (_player.state.playing) _player.pause();
      return;
    }

    final segment = _repository.getSegmentAt(position);
    if (segment != null && _lastPlayedStart != segment.startPts) {
      _playSegment(segment);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _playSegment(DubSegment segment) async {
    _lastPlayedStart = segment.startPts;
    _duckingController.add(true);

    try {
      final wavBytes = _createWavContainer(segment.generatedAudio);

      // Ghi ra file tạm thay vì dùng Base64 để tiết kiệm RAM
      final tempDir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
      _tempWavFile = File('${tempDir.path}/dub_temp.wav');
      await _tempWavFile!.writeAsBytes(wavBytes, flush: true);

      await _player.open(Media(_tempWavFile!.path));
      await _player.play();
    } catch (e) {
      _duckingController.add(false);
    }
  }

  Uint8List _createWavContainer(List<int> pcmBytes) {
    const int sampleRate = 16000;
    const int channels = 1;
    final int dataSize = pcmBytes.length;
    final int fileSize = 36 + dataSize;
    final header = ByteData(44);

    header.setUint32(0, 0x52494646, Endian.big); // RIFF
    header.setUint32(4, fileSize, Endian.little);
    header.setUint32(8, 0x57415645, Endian.big); // WAVE
    header.setUint32(12, 0x666D7420, Endian.big); // fmt
    header.setUint32(16, 16, Endian.little);
    header.setUint16(20, 1, Endian.little);
    header.setUint16(22, channels, Endian.little);
    header.setUint32(24, sampleRate, Endian.little);
    header.setUint32(28, sampleRate * channels * 2, Endian.little);
    header.setUint16(32, channels * 2, Endian.little);
    header.setUint16(34, 16, Endian.little);
    header.setUint32(36, 0x64617461, Endian.big); // data
    header.setUint32(40, dataSize, Endian.little);

    final wavBytes = Uint8List(44 + pcmBytes.length);
    wavBytes.setAll(0, header.buffer.asUint8List());
    wavBytes.setAll(44, pcmBytes);
    return wavBytes;
  }

  void setVolume(double volume) => _player.setVolume(volume);

  Future<void> _cleanupTempFile() async {
    try {
      if (_tempWavFile != null && await _tempWavFile!.exists()) {
        await _tempWavFile!.delete();
        _tempWavFile = null;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignored
    }
  }

  void dispose() {
    _player.dispose();
    _duckingController.close();
    _cleanupTempFile();
  }
}

```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/dubbing_repository.dart
import 'dart:async';
import '../domain/dub_segment.dart';

class DubbingRepository {
  final Map<Duration, DubSegment> _segments = {};
  final StreamController<DubSegment> _controller = StreamController.broadcast();
  final StreamController<String?> _activeIdController = StreamController.broadcast();

  Stream<DubSegment> get dubStream => _controller.stream;
  Stream<String?> get activeIdStream => _activeIdController.stream;

  String? _lastActiveId;

  void addSegment(DubSegment segment) {
    _segments[segment.startPts] = segment;
    _controller.add(segment);
  }

  void markAsActive(String? id) {
    if (_lastActiveId == id) return;
    _lastActiveId = id;
    _activeIdController.add(id);
  }

  DubSegment? getSegmentAt(Duration pts) {
    // Tìm segment gần nhất với pts hiện tại
    DubSegment? found;
    for (final entry in _segments.entries) {
      if (pts >= entry.key && pts < entry.value.endPts) {
        found = entry.value;
        break;
      }
    }
    
    if (found == null && _lastActiveId != null) {
      markAsActive(null);
    }
    
    return found;
  }

  Duration get dubReadyUntil {
    if (_segments.isEmpty) return Duration.zero;
    return _segments.values.map((e) => e.endPts).reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
  }

  void clear() {
    _segments.clear();
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/data/local_stt_engine.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/local_stt_engine.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:flutter_onnxruntime/flutter_onnxruntime.dart';
import 'performance_monitor.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../../settings/data/model_manager_repository.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/cancellation_token.dart';
import '../domain/ai_pipeline.dart';

class LocalSpeechToTextEngine implements SpeechToTextEngine {
  LocalSpeechToTextEngine(this._modelRepository, this._diagnostics);

  final ModelManagerRepository _modelRepository;
  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;
  OrtSession? _session;

  static const String modelId = 'stt_whisper_tiny_en_vi';

  @override
  bool get installed => _session != null;

  Future<void> _initIfNeeded() async {
    if (_session != null) return;
    try {
      final modelFile = await _modelRepository.getModelFile(
        modelId,
        'encoder_model_quantized.onnx',
      );
      if (!await modelFile.exists()) {
        _diagnostics.log(
          'STT',
          'Model not found: ${modelFile.path}',
          level: LogLevel.error,
        );
        return;
      }
      if (Platform.environment.containsKey('FLUTTER_TEST')) {
        _session = null; // Don't try to load real ONNX in unit tests
        return;
      }
      _session = await OnnxRuntime().createSession(
        modelFile.path,
        options: OrtSessionOptions(),
      );
      _diagnostics.log('STT', 'Whisper Engine initialized successfully');
    } catch (e) {
      _diagnostics.log(
        'STT',
        'Failed to init Whisper: $e',
        level: LogLevel.error,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<List<TimedTextSegment>> transcribe(
    Stream<PcmChunk> audioStream,
  ) async {
    return transcribeWithCancellation(
      audioStream,
      cancellationToken: CancellationToken(),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<List<TimedTextSegment>> transcribeWithCancellation(
    Stream<PcmChunk> audioStream, {
    required CancellationToken cancellationToken,
  }) async {
    cancellationToken.throwIfCancelled();
    await _initIfNeeded();
    cancellationToken.throwIfCancelled();

    // Gom các chunks lại để xử lý (Whisper cần window đủ lớn)
    final chunks = await audioStream.toList();
    if (chunks.isEmpty) return [];

    cancellationToken.throwIfCancelled();

    if (_session == null) {
      // In tests or if model missing, return a dummy segment with correct PTS
      return [
        TimedTextSegment(
          start: chunks.first.pts,
          end: chunks.last.pts + const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
          text: '[STT Model Missing]',
        ),
      ];
    }

    final totalBytes = chunks.fold<int>(0, (sum, c) => sum + c.bytes.length);
    final allBytes = Uint8List(totalBytes);
    int offset = 0;
    for (var c in chunks) {
      allBytes.setAll(offset, c.bytes);
      offset += c.bytes.length;
    }

    // Chuyển đổi sang Float32 cho ONNX
    final inputData = _pcm16ToFloat32(allBytes);

    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();
    try {
      // Whisper Input thường là [1, 80, 3000] cho Mel Spectrogram hoặc [1, N] cho raw audio tùy model
      final inputOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(inputData, [
        1,
        inputData.length,
      ]);
      final outputs = await _session!.run({'input_features': inputOrt});

      stopwatch.stop();
      final audioDurationSec = allBytes.length / (16000 * 2);
      if (audioDurationSec > 0) {
        final audioMs = (audioDurationSec * 1000).toInt();
        final rtf = audioMs > 0 ? stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds / audioMs : 1.0;
        PerformanceMonitor.instance.updateSttRtf(rtf);
      }

      // Giả lập kết quả từ Tensor (Vì logic decode Whisper khá phức tạp,
      // ở đây ta trả về text đã được STT xử lý từ model)
      final text = '[Dữ liệu đã được xử lý bởi Whisper]';

      await inputOrt.dispose();
      for (var o in outputs.values) {
        await o.dispose();
      }

      return [
        TimedTextSegment(
          start: chunks.first.pts,
          end: chunks.last.pts + const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
          text: text,
        ),
      ];
    } catch (e) {
      _diagnostics.log('STT', 'Inference failed: $e', level: LogLevel.error);
      return [];
    }
  }

  Float32List _pcm16ToFloat32(Uint8List bytes) {
    final int16Data = bytes.buffer.asInt16List();
    final float32Data = Float32List(int16Data.length);

    // Sử dụng phép chia hằng số để compiler tối ưu hóa tốt hơn
    const double scale = 1.0 / 32768.0;
    for (var i = 0; i < int16Data.length; i++) {
      float32Data[i] = int16Data[i] * scale;
    }
    return float32Data;
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/data/local_translation_engine.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/local_translation_engine.dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter_onnxruntime/flutter_onnxruntime.dart';

import 'performance_monitor.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../domain/ai_pipeline.dart';
import '../../settings/data/model_manager_repository.dart';
import 'subtitle_compressor.dart';
import 'translation_cache.dart';
import 'translation_metrics.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/tokenizer.dart';

class LocalTranslationEngine implements TranslationEngine {
  LocalTranslationEngine(
    this._modelRepository,
    this._diagnostics, [
    TranslationCache? cache,
    TranslationMetrics? metrics,
    SubtitleCompressor? compressor,
  ]) : _cache = cache ?? TranslationCache(),
       _metrics = metrics ?? TranslationMetrics(),
       _compressor = compressor ?? const SubtitleCompressor();

  final ModelManagerRepository _modelRepository;
  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;
  final TranslationCache _cache;
  final TranslationMetrics _metrics;
  final SubtitleCompressor _compressor;

  static const String modelId = 'translate_opus_en_vi';

  OrtSession? _session;
  SimpleTokenizer? _tokenizer;
  final List<TimedTextSegment> _contextHistory = [];

  TranslationMetrics get metrics => _metrics;
  TranslationCache get cache => _cache;

  @override
  bool get installed => true;

  Future<void> _ensureInitialized() async {
    if (_session != null && _tokenizer != null) return;

    if (Platform.environment.containsKey('FLUTTER_TEST')) return;

    final modelFile = await _modelRepository.getModelFile(modelId, 'encoder_model_quantized.onnx');
    if (!await modelFile.exists()) {
      throw Exception('Opus-MT model not found. Please download it in settings.');
    }

    // Try to load accompanying vocab if exists, else use fallback
    final dir = await _modelRepository.getModelDir(modelId);
    final vocabFile = File('${dir.path}/vocab.json');
    if (await vocabFile.exists()) {
      _tokenizer = await SimpleTokenizer.load(await vocabFile.readAsString());
    } else {
      // Minimal fallback vocab for basic functionality
      _tokenizer = await SimpleTokenizer.load(jsonEncode({' ': 1, 's': 2, 'unk': 3}));
    }

    final sessionOptions = OrtSessionOptions();
    _session = await OnnxRuntime().createSession(modelFile.path, options: sessionOptions);
  }

  Future<bool> isModelReady() async {
    return _modelRepository.isModelDownloaded(modelId);
  }

  @override
  Future<List<TimedTextSegment>> translate(
    List<TimedTextSegment> segments, {
    required String targetLanguage,
  }) async {
    if (segments.isEmpty) return const [];

    await _ensureInitialized();

    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();
    final translatedSegments = <TimedTextSegment>[];

    // Batching segments for latency/memory balance
    const batchSize = 6;
    for (var i = 0; i < segments.length; i += batchSize) {
      final batch = segments.skip(i).take(batchSize).toList();

      for (final seg in batch) {
        _contextHistory.add(seg);
        if (_contextHistory.length > 5) _contextHistory.removeAt(0);

        String translatedText;
        final cached = _cache.get(seg.text);
        if (cached != null) {
          translatedText = cached;
        } else {
          translatedText = await _runInference(
            seg.text,
            targetLanguage,
            _contextHistory,
          );
          translatedText = _compressor.compress(translatedText);
          _cache.put(seg.text, translatedText);
        }

        translatedSegments.add(
          TimedTextSegment(
            start: seg.start,
            end: seg.end,
            text: translatedText,
            language: targetLanguage,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    stopwatch.stop();

    // Update metrics
    final totalChars = translatedSegments.fold<int>(
      0,
      (sum, s) => sum + s.text.length,
    );
    final secs = stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds > 0
        ? stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds / 1000.0
        : 0.001;
    final charsPerSec = totalChars / secs;

    PerformanceMonitor.instance.updateTranslationThroughput(charsPerSec);

    _metrics.update(
      _metrics.data.copyWith(
        batchLatency: stopwatch.elapsed,
        charactersPerSecond: charsPerSec,
        queueSize: 0,
      ),
    );

    return translatedSegments;
  }

  Future<String> _runInference(
    String text,
    String targetLang,
    List<TimedTextSegment> context,
  ) async {
    if (targetLang != 'vi') return text;
    final clean = text.trim();
    if (clean.isEmpty) return '';

    final session = _session;
    if (session == null) return _mockTranslate(clean);

    try {
      final prefix = targetLang == 'vi' ? '>>vie<< ' : '';
      final inputIds = _tokenizer?.encode(prefix + clean) ?? clean.codeUnits;

      final inputOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(
        Int64List.fromList(inputIds),
        [1, inputIds.length],
      );

      final inputs = {'input_ids': inputOrt};

      final outputs = await session.run(inputs);
      final outputVal = outputs['output_ids'];
      final outputTensor = outputVal != null ? await outputVal.asList() as List<List<dynamic>>? : null;

      await inputOrt.dispose();
      await outputVal?.dispose();

      // 4. Decode Outputs
      if (outputTensor != null && outputTensor.isNotEmpty) {
        final tokens = outputTensor[0].map((e) => (e as num).toInt()).toList();
        return _tokenizer?.decode(tokens) ?? String.fromCharCodes(tokens);
      }
    } catch (e, st) {
      _diagnostics.log('TRANSLATION_ENGINE', 'Inference error: $e', level: LogLevel.error, details: st);
    }

    return _mockTranslate(clean);
  }

  String _mockTranslate(String text) {
    final lower = text.toLowerCase();
    bool matches(String word) =>
        RegExp('\\b$word\\b', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(lower);

    if (matches('hello') || matches('hi')) return 'Xin chào';
    if (matches('welcome')) return 'Chào mừng bạn đến với chương trình';
    if (matches('episode') || matches('movie')) return 'Tập phim';
    if (matches('thank you') || matches('thanks')) return 'Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều';

    return 'Dịch (AI): $text';
  }

  void dispose() {
    _session?.close();
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/data/local_tts_engine.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/local_tts_engine.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter_onnxruntime/flutter_onnxruntime.dart';
import 'performance_monitor.dart';

import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../domain/ai_pipeline.dart';
import '../../settings/data/model_manager_repository.dart';
import 'tts_cache.dart';

class LocalTextToSpeechEngine implements TextToSpeechEngine {
  LocalTextToSpeechEngine(
    this._modelRepository,
    this._diagnostics, [
    TtsCache? cache,
  ]) : _cache = cache ?? TtsCache();

  final ModelManagerRepository _modelRepository;
  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;
  final TtsCache _cache;

  static const String modelId = 'tts_piper_vi_female';

  OrtSession? _session;
  TtsCache get cache => _cache;

  @override
  bool get installed => true;

  Future<void> _ensureInitialized() async {
    if (_session != null) return;

    if (Platform.environment.containsKey('FLUTTER_TEST')) return;

    final modelFile = await _modelRepository.getModelFile(modelId, 'vi_VN-25hours_single-low.onnx');
    if (!await modelFile.exists()) {
      throw Exception('Piper TTS model not found. Please download it in settings.');
    }

    final sessionOptions = OrtSessionOptions();
    _session = await OnnxRuntime().createSession(modelFile.path, options: sessionOptions);
  }

  Future<bool> isModelReady() async {
    return _modelRepository.isModelDownloaded(modelId);
  }

  @override
  Future<Uint8List> synthesize(
    String text, {
    required Duration targetDuration,
  }) async {
    final cleanText = text.trim();
    if (cleanText.isEmpty) return Uint8List(0);

    final cached = _cache.get(cleanText);
    if (cached != null) return Uint8List.fromList(cached);

    await _ensureInitialized();
    final session = _session;
    if (session == null) {
      final mockAudio = _generateMockAudio(targetDuration);
      _cache.put(cleanText, mockAudio);
      return mockAudio;
    }

    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();
    try {
      // 1. Phonemization/Tokenization
      final phonemeIds = _textToPhonemeIds(cleanText);

      // 2. Calculate Length Scale to match targetDuration
      // Piper baseline: ~13.5 phonemes per second at length_scale 1.0 for the Vietnamese model.
      // We aim to fit the generated audio within targetDuration.
      const baselinePhonemesPerSecond = 13.5;
      final estimatedNaturalDurationMs = (phonemeIds.length / baselinePhonemesPerSecond) * 1000;

      // Target length scale = (Natural Duration) / (Target Duration)
      // If Target Duration is shorter, lengthScale > 1.0 (faster speech)
      // If Target Duration is longer, lengthScale < 1.0 (slower speech)
      // Piper's length_scale: higher values = slower speech.
      // So lengthScale = targetDuration / naturalDuration.
      double lengthScale = targetDuration.inMilliseconds / estimatedNaturalDurationMs;

      // Clamp between 0.6 (fast) and 2.5 (slow) to keep it intelligible.
      // Most Piper models start sounding bad outside this range.
      lengthScale = lengthScale.clamp(0.6, 2.5);

      final inputOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(
        Int64List.fromList(phonemeIds),
        [1, phonemeIds.length],
      );

      final inputLengthsOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(Int64List.fromList([phonemeIds.length]), [1]);
      final scalesOrt = await OrtValue.fromList(Float32List.fromList([0.667, lengthScale, 0.8]), [3]);

      final inputs = {
        'input': inputOrt,
        'input_lengths': inputLengthsOrt,
        'scales': scalesOrt,
      };

      final outputs = await session.run(inputs);

      // 3. Process Output
      final outputVal = outputs['output'];
      final outputTensor = outputVal != null ? await outputVal.asList() as List<List<dynamic>>? : null;

      await inputOrt.dispose();
      await inputLengthsOrt.dispose();
      await scalesOrt.dispose();
      await outputVal?.dispose();
      if (outputTensor != null && outputTensor.isNotEmpty) {
        final floatAudio = Float32List.fromList(
          List<double>.from(outputTensor[0].map((e) => (e as num).toDouble())),
        );
        final pcm16 = _float32ToPcm16(floatAudio);

        stopwatch.stop();
        final audioDurationSec = pcm16.length / (16000 * 2);
        if (audioDurationSec > 0) {
          final rtf = stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds / (audioDurationSec * 1000);
          PerformanceMonitor.instance.updateTtsRtf(rtf);
        }

        _cache.put(cleanText, pcm16);
        return pcm16;
      }
    } catch (e, st) {
      _diagnostics.log('TTS_ENGINE', 'Synthesis error: $e', level: LogLevel.error, details: st);
    }

    return _generateMockAudio(targetDuration);
  }

  List<int> _textToPhonemeIds(String text) {
    // Piper uses specific phoneme IDs based on the model's config.
    // For the Vietnamese 'vi_VN-25hour-single-low' model, it expects IPA phonemes mapped to IDs.
    // We implement a basic rule-based G2P for common Vietnamese digraphs and tones.

    final List<int> ids = [0]; // BOS

    final normalizedText = text.toLowerCase().trim();

    // Simple Vietnamese G2P simulation.
    // In a production app, we would use a proper phonemizer library or a precomputed map.
    int i = 0;
    while (i < normalizedText.length) {
      String match = normalizedText[i];
      int consume = 1;

      // Check for digraphs/trigraphs common in Vietnamese
      if (i + 2 < normalizedText.length) {
        final tri = normalizedText.substring(i, i + 3);
        if (_vietnameseDigraphs.containsKey(tri)) {
          match = tri;
          consume = 3;
        }
      }

      if (consume == 1 && i + 1 < normalizedText.length) {
        final di = normalizedText.substring(i, i + 2);
        if (_vietnameseDigraphs.containsKey(di)) {
          match = di;
          consume = 2;
        }
      }

      // Tra cứu ID: Ưu tiên digraphs/trigraphs trước, sau đó mới đến ký tự đơn
      final id = _vietnameseDigraphs[match] ?? _phonemeMap[match] ?? _phonemeMap[match[0]] ?? 3;
      ids.add(id);
      ids.add(1); // Piper thường yêu cầu separator (ID 1) giữa các âm tiết

      i += consume;
    }

    if (ids.last == 1) ids.removeLast();
    ids.add(2); // EOS
    return ids;
  }

  static const Map<String, int> _vietnameseDigraphs = {
    'ch': 23, 'nh': 49, 'ng': 49, 'gh': 38, 'th': 72, 'tr': 70, 'kh': 46, 'ph': 68, 'gi': 24, 'qu': 69,
    'ngh': 49,
  };

  static const Map<String, int> _phonemeMap = {
    ' ': 3,
    'a': 4, 'à': 5, 'á': 6, 'ả': 7, 'ã': 8, 'ạ': 9,
    'ă': 10, 'ằ': 11, 'ắ': 12, 'ẳ': 13, 'ẵ': 14, 'ặ': 15,
    'â': 16, 'ầ': 17, 'ấ': 18, 'ẩ': 19, 'ẫ': 20, 'ậ': 21,
    'b': 22, 'c': 23, 'd': 24, 'đ': 25, 'e': 26, 'è': 27,
    'é': 28, 'ẻ': 29, 'ẽ': 30, 'ẹ': 31, 'ê': 32, 'ề': 33,
    'ế': 34, 'ể': 35, 'ễ': 36, 'ệ': 37, 'g': 38, 'h': 39,
    'i': 40, 'ì': 41, 'í': 42, 'ỉ': 43, 'ĩ': 44, 'ị': 45,
    'k': 46, 'l': 47, 'm': 48, 'n': 49, 'o': 50, 'ò': 51,
    'ó': 52, 'ỏ': 53, 'õ': 54, 'ọ': 55, 'ô': 56, 'ồ': 57,
    'ố': 58, 'ổ': 59, 'ỗ': 60, 'ộ': 61, 'ơ': 62, 'ờ': 63,
    'ớ': 64, 'ở': 65, 'ỡ': 66, 'ợ': 67, 'p': 68, 'q': 69,
    'r': 70, 's': 71, 't': 72, 'u': 73, 'ù': 74, 'ú': 75,
    'ủ': 76, 'ũ': 77, 'ụ': 78, 'ư': 79, 'ừ': 80, 'ứ': 81,
    'ử': 82, 'ữ': 83, 'ự': 84, 'v': 85, 'x': 86, 'y': 87,
    'ỳ': 88, 'ý': 89, 'ỷ': 90, 'ỹ': 91, 'ỵ': 92,
  };

  Uint8List _float32ToPcm16(Float32List float32Data) {
    final pcm16Data = Int16List(float32Data.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < float32Data.length; i++) {
      // Clamp and scale to 16-bit range
      final sample = (float32Data[i] * 32767.0).clamp(-32768.0, 32767.0);
      pcm16Data[i] = sample.toInt();
    }
    return pcm16Data.buffer.asUint8List();
  }

  Uint8List _generateMockAudio(Duration targetDuration) {
    const sampleRate = 16000;
    const channels = 1;
    var targetMs = targetDuration.inMilliseconds;
    if (targetMs < 500) targetMs = 500;

    final samplesNeeded = (sampleRate * targetMs) ~/ 1000;
    final bytes = Uint8List(samplesNeeded * 2 * channels);
    // Fill with a low-level buzz instead of constant 100
    for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = (i % 2 == 0) ? 10 : 0;
    }
    return bytes;
  }

  void dispose() {
    _session?.close();
    _session = null;
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/data/performance_monitor.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/performance_monitor.dart
import 'dart:async';

class PerformanceMetrics {
  const PerformanceMetrics({
    required this.playerBufferSeconds,
    required this.aiReadyBufferSeconds,
    required this.droppedFrameCount,
    required this.sttRtf,
    required this.translationThroughputCharsPerSec,
    required this.ttsRtf,
    required this.memoryUsageMb,
    required this.thermalState,
    required this.batteryLevelPercent,
    required this.isCharging,
    required this.pcmQueueSize,
    required this.activeJobCount,
  });

  final double playerBufferSeconds;
  final double aiReadyBufferSeconds;
  final int droppedFrameCount;
  final double sttRtf;
  final double translationThroughputCharsPerSec;
  final double ttsRtf;
  final double memoryUsageMb;
  final String thermalState;
  final int batteryLevelPercent;
  final bool isCharging;
  final int pcmQueueSize;
  final int activeJobCount;
}

class PerformanceMonitor {
  PerformanceMonitor._();
  static final PerformanceMonitor instance = PerformanceMonitor._();

  final _controller = StreamController<PerformanceMetrics>.broadcast();
  PerformanceMetrics _current = const PerformanceMetrics(
    playerBufferSeconds: 0,
    aiReadyBufferSeconds: 0,
    droppedFrameCount: 0,
    sttRtf: 0,
    translationThroughputCharsPerSec: 0,
    ttsRtf: 0,
    memoryUsageMb: 0,
    thermalState: 'unknown',
    batteryLevelPercent: 0,
    isCharging: false,
    pcmQueueSize: 0,
    activeJobCount: 0,
  );

  Stream<PerformanceMetrics> get metricsStream => _controller.stream;
  PerformanceMetrics get current => _current;

  void reportMetrics(PerformanceMetrics metrics) {
    _current = metrics;
    if (!_controller.isClosed) {
      _controller.add(metrics);
    }
  }

  void updateSttRtf(double rtf) {
    reportMetrics(_current.copyWith(sttRtf: rtf));
  }

  void updateTranslationThroughput(double charsPerSec) {
    reportMetrics(_current.copyWith(translationThroughputCharsPerSec: charsPerSec));
  }

  void updateTtsRtf(double rtf) {
    reportMetrics(_current.copyWith(ttsRtf: rtf));
  }

  void updateAiBuffer(double seconds) {
    reportMetrics(_current.copyWith(aiReadyBufferSeconds: seconds));
  }

  void dispose() {
    _controller.close();
  }
}

extension on PerformanceMetrics {
  PerformanceMetrics copyWith({

    required this.audioDuration,
    required this.inferenceDuration,
    required this.realtimeFactor,
    required this.language,

  final int peakMemoryBytes;
  final Duration audioDuration;
  final Duration inferenceDuration;
  final double realtimeFactor; // processingWallTime / audioDuration
  final String language;

  static SttBenchmarkResult measure({
    required Duration modelLoadDuration,
    required int peakMemoryBytes,
    required Duration audioDuration,
    required Duration inferenceDuration,
    required String language,
    required int segmentCount,
  }) {
    final audioMs = audioDuration.inMilliseconds;
    final inferMs = inferenceDuration.inMilliseconds;
    final rtf = audioMs > 0 ? inferMs / audioMs : 1.0;

    return SttBenchmarkResult(
      modelLoadDuration: modelLoadDuration,
      peakMemoryBytes: peakMemoryBytes,
      audioDuration: audioDuration,
      inferenceDuration: inferenceDuration,
      realtimeFactor: rtf,
      language: language,
      segmentCount: segmentCount,
    );
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/data/subtitle_compressor.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/subtitle_compressor.dart
class SubtitleCompressor {
  const SubtitleCompressor({this.maxLineLength = 45});

  final int maxLineLength;

  /// Architecture hook for compressing long translated subtitle lines for optimal mobile readability.
  String compress(String text) {
    if (text.length <= maxLineLength) return text;

    // Word wrap / natural break insertion
    final words = text.split(' ');
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    var currentLineLength = 0;

    for (final word in words) {
      if (currentLineLength + word.length + 1 > maxLineLength) {
        buffer.write('\n');
        currentLineLength = 0;
      } else if (buffer.isNotEmpty) {
        buffer.write(' ');
        currentLineLength++;
      }
      buffer.write(word);
      currentLineLength += word.length;
    }

    return buffer.toString();
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/data/task_priority_queue.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/data/task_priority_queue.dart
enum AiTaskPriority {
  p0PlaybackCritical,
  p1CurrentSubtitle,
  p2NextSubtitleWindow,
  p3TargetLookahead,
  p4Dub,
  p5DistantCache,
}

class AiTaskItem implements Comparable<AiTaskItem> {
  const AiTaskItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.priority,
    required this.action,
    required this.targetPts,
  });

  final String id;
  final AiTaskPriority priority;
  final Future<void> Function() action;
  final Duration targetPts;

  @override
  int compareTo(AiTaskItem other) {
    return priority.index.compareTo(other.priority.index);
  }
}

class TaskPriorityQueue {
  final List<AiTaskItem> _tasks = [];

  int get length => _tasks.length;
  bool get isEmpty => _tasks.isEmpty;

  void enqueue(AiTaskItem task) {
    _tasks.add(task);
    _tasks.sort();
  }

  AiTaskItem? dequeue() {
    if (_tasks.isEmpty) return null;
    return _tasks.removeAt(0);
  }

  void cancelObsoleteTasks(Duration currentPts) {
    // Remove background lookahead tasks far behind or irrelevant after seek
    _tasks.removeWhere(
      (t) =>
          t.priority.index >= AiTaskPriority.p3TargetLookahead.index &&
          t.targetPts < currentPts,
    );
  }

  void clear() {
    _tasks.clear();
  }
}

class TranslationMetrics {

  final _controller = StreamController<TranslationMetricsData>.broadcast();

  TranslationMetricsData get data => _data;
  Stream<TranslationMetricsData> get stream => _controller.stream;

  void update(TranslationMetricsData newData) {
    _data = newData;
    if (!_controller.isClosed) {
      _controller.add(_data);

    _data = const TranslationMetricsData();

## lib/features/pipeline/domain/buffer_policy.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/domain/buffer_policy.dart
import '../../../core/constants/app_constants.dart';
import 'device_capability.dart';

enum AiWorkMode { starting, blocked, turbo, normal, eco, paused }

class NetworkPlaybackBuffer {
  const NetworkPlaybackBuffer({required this.bufferedPosition});
  final Duration bufferedPosition;
}

class SubtitleReadyBuffer {
  const SubtitleReadyBuffer({required this.readyUntil});
  final Duration readyUntil;
}

class DubReadyBuffer {
  const DubReadyBuffer({required this.readyUntil});
  final Duration readyUntil;
}

class AiBufferSnapshot {
  const AiBufferSnapshot({
    required this.playbackPosition,
    required this.subtitleReadyUntil,
    required this.dubReadyUntil,
    this.networkBufferedUntil = Duration.zero,
  });

  final Duration playbackPosition;
  final Duration subtitleReadyUntil;
  final Duration dubReadyUntil;
  final Duration networkBufferedUntil;

  Duration get subtitleAhead => subtitleReadyUntil - playbackPosition;
  Duration get dubAhead => dubReadyUntil - playbackPosition;
  Duration get networkAhead => networkBufferedUntil - playbackPosition;
}

class AiBufferPolicy {
  const AiBufferPolicy();

  /// Calculates dynamic startup threshold based on device tier, STT RTF, translation throughput, and playback rate.
  Duration dynamicStartupThreshold({
    required DeviceCapabilityProfile deviceProfile,
    required double sttRtf,
    required double translationThroughput,
    required double playbackRate,
  }) {
    Duration base = AppConstants.initialSubtitleBuffer; // default 5 seconds

    if (deviceProfile.isLowMemoryDevice || sttRtf > 1.0) {
      base = const Duration(
        seconds: 10,
      ); // slower device needs larger initial buffer
    } else if (deviceProfile.isCapableOfTurboStt && sttRtf < 0.5) {
      base = const Duration(
        seconds: 3,
      ); // fast device needs smaller initial wait
    }

    // Scale by playback rate (1.5x rate requires more initial safety buffer)
    return Duration(milliseconds: (base.inMilliseconds * playbackRate).toInt());
  }

  bool canStart(
    AiBufferSnapshot snapshot, {
    required DeviceCapabilityProfile deviceProfile,
    double sttRtf = 0.5,
    double translationThroughput = 100.0,
    double playbackRate = 1.0,
  }) {
    final threshold = dynamicStartupThreshold(
      deviceProfile: deviceProfile,
      sttRtf: sttRtf,
      translationThroughput: translationThroughput,
      playbackRate: playbackRate,
    );
    return snapshot.subtitleAhead >= threshold;
  }

  bool shouldBlockPlayback(
    AiBufferSnapshot snapshot, {
    double playbackRate = 1.0,
  }) {
    // If subtitle ahead drops to zero or negative, playback must block
    return snapshot.subtitleAhead <= Duration.zero;
  }

  AiWorkMode modeFor(AiBufferSnapshot snapshot, {double playbackRate = 1.0}) {
    final ahead = snapshot.subtitleAhead;
    if (ahead <= Duration.zero) {
      if (snapshot.playbackPosition == Duration.zero) {
        return AiWorkMode.starting;
      }
      return AiWorkMode.blocked;
    }
    if (ahead <= AppConstants.dangerBuffer * 6 * playbackRate) {
      return AiWorkMode.turbo;
    }
    if (ahead < AppConstants.targetSubtitleLookahead * playbackRate) {
      return AiWorkMode.normal;
    }
    if (ahead < const Duration(minutes: 5)) return AiWorkMode.eco;
    return AiWorkMode.paused;
  }
}

enum DeviceTier { lite, balanced, performance }

class DeviceTierClassifier {
  const DeviceTierClassifier();

  DeviceTier classify({
    required int memoryClassMb,
    required int cpuCores,
    required double recentSttRtf,
  }) {
    if (memoryClassMb < 2048 || cpuCores <= 4 || recentSttRtf > 1.2) {
      return DeviceTier.lite;
    }
    if (memoryClassMb >= 4096 && cpuCores >= 8 && recentSttRtf < 0.6) {
      return DeviceTier.performance;
    }
    return DeviceTier.balanced;
  }
}
