```dart:lib/features/pipeline/domain/media_identity.dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';

class MediaIdentity {
  const MediaIdentity({
    required this.normalizedPath,
    required this.durationSeconds,
    this.title,
    this.episode,
    this.streamCharacteristics = 'hls_video',
  });

  final String normalizedPath;
  final int durationSeconds;
  final String? title;
  final String? episode;
  final String streamCharacteristics;

  /// Generates a robust layered fingerprint that is immune to ephemeral CDN query token changes.
  String generateFingerprint() {
    // Strip ephemeral query parameters or signed tokens from URI path
    Uri uri;
    try {
      uri = Uri.parse(normalizedPath);
    } catch (_) {
      uri = Uri(path: normalizedPath);
    }

    final cleanPath = '${uri.scheme}://${uri.host}${uri.path}'
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim();
    final rawKey =
        '$cleanPath|$durationSeconds|${(title ?? '').toLowerCase().trim()}|${(episode ?? '').toLowerCase().trim()}|$streamCharacteristics';

    final bytes = utf8.encode(rawKey);
    return sha256.convert(bytes).toString();
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/domain/playback_gate.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/domain/playback_gate.dart
import 'buffer_policy.dart';

class PlaybackGateDecision {
  const PlaybackGateDecision({
    required this.shouldPlay,
    required this.reason,
    required this.workMode,
  });

  final bool shouldPlay;
  final String reason;
  final AiWorkMode workMode;
}

class PlaybackGate {
  const PlaybackGate();

  PlaybackGateDecision evaluate({
    required AiBufferSnapshot snapshot,
    required double playbackRate,
    required bool isUserPaused,
  }) {
    if (isUserPaused) {
      return const PlaybackGateDecision(
        shouldPlay: false,
        reason: 'User paused playback explicitly.',
        workMode: AiWorkMode.paused,
      );
    }

    // Adjust required buffer ahead by playback rate (1.5x rate requires 1.5x buffer)
    final adjustedSubtitleAhead = snapshot.subtitleAhead;
    const policy = AiBufferPolicy();
    final mode = policy.modeFor(snapshot, playbackRate: playbackRate);
    final shouldBlock = policy.shouldBlockPlayback(
      snapshot,
      playbackRate: playbackRate,
    );

    if (shouldBlock) {
      return PlaybackGateDecision(
        shouldPlay: false,
        reason:
            'Subtitle buffer exhausted (ahead: ${adjustedSubtitleAhead.inMilliseconds}ms). Pausing playback to refill AI buffer.',
        workMode: mode,
      );
    }

    return PlaybackGateDecision(
      shouldPlay: true,
      reason:
          'Subtitle buffer healthy (mode: ${mode.name}). Playback proceeding.',
      workMode: mode,
    );
  }
}

```dart:lib/features/pipeline/domain/timeline_subtitle_buffer.dart
import 'ai_pipeline.dart';

class TimelineSubtitleBuffer {
  final List<TimedTextSegment> _segments = [];
  Duration _processedUntil = Duration.zero;

  List<TimedTextSegment> get segments => List.unmodifiable(_segments);

  Duration get subtitleReadyUntil {
    final lastSegmentEnd = _segments.isEmpty
        ? Duration.zero
        : _segments.last.end;
    return lastSegmentEnd > _processedUntil ? lastSegmentEnd : _processedUntil;
  }

  void reportProgress(Duration pts) {
    if (pts > _processedUntil) {
      _processedUntil = pts;
    }
  }

  void addSegments(List<TimedTextSegment> newSegments) {
    _segments.addAll(newSegments);
    _segments.sort((a, b) => a.start.compareTo(b.start));
  }

  TimedTextSegment? segmentAt(Duration pts) {
    for (final seg in _segments) {
      if (pts >= seg.start && pts <= seg.end) {
        return seg;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// Prunes obsolete segments older than 60 seconds from current playhead position
  void pruneObsolete(Duration currentPts) {
    final cutoffPts = currentPts - const Duration(seconds: 60);
    if (cutoffPts > Duration.zero) {
      _segments.removeWhere((seg) => seg.end < cutoffPts);
    }
  }

  void flushObsolete(Duration beforePts) {
    _segments.removeWhere((seg) => seg.end < beforePts);
    if (beforePts > _processedUntil) {
      _processedUntil = beforePts;
    }
  }

  void clear() {
    _segments.clear();
    _processedUntil = Duration.zero;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AiBufferPanel extends ConsumerWidget {
  const AiBufferPanel({required this.source, super.key});
  final ResolvedSource source;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final aiState = ref.watch(aiSchedulerProvider);
    final isNative = source.playbackMode == PlaybackMode.native;

    final aheadSeconds = aiState.subtitleAhead.inSeconds.clamp(0, 999);
    final modeColor = switch (aiState.workMode) {
      AiWorkMode.starting => Colors.purpleAccent,
      AiWorkMode.blocked => Colors.redAccent,
      AiWorkMode.turbo => Colors.orangeAccent,
      AiWorkMode.normal => Colors.greenAccent,
      AiWorkMode.eco => Colors.blueAccent,
      AiWorkMode.paused => Colors.grey,
    };

    return Material(
      color: const Color(0xFF14141A),
      elevation: 4,
      child: StreamBuilder<PerformanceMetrics>(
        stream: PerformanceMonitor.instance.metricsStream,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          final metrics = snapshot.data ?? PerformanceMonitor.instance.current;
          
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 16),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      isNative ? Icons.auto_awesome : Icons.language,
                      color: const Color(0xFF7C5CFC),
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            aiState.errorMessage ?? aiState.activeSourceStrategy,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              fontSize: 13,
                              color: aiState.errorMessage != null ? Colors.redAccent : Colors.white,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                            'RTF: STT ${metrics.sttRtf.toStringAsFixed(2)}x | TTS ${metrics.ttsRtf.toStringAsFixed(2)}x',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Colors.white54),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        showModalBottomSheet(
                          context: context,
                          isScrollControlled: true,
                          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                          builder: (context) => const SizedBox(
                            height: 600,
                            child: ClipRRect(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
                              child: Material(child: DiagnosticLogOverlay()),
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 8,
                          vertical: 3,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: modeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: modeColor, width: 1),

                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            if (aiState.workMode == AiWorkMode.blocked)
                              const Icon(Icons.bug_report, color: Colors.white, size: 12),
                            const SizedBox(width: 4),
                            Text(
                              aiState.workMode.name.toUpperCase(),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: modeColor,
                                fontSize: 10,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      'Subtitle Lookahead Buffer:',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.white70),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    Text(
                      '${aheadSeconds}s ahead',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: (aheadSeconds / 120.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                    backgroundColor: Colors.white12,
                    color: modeColor,
                    minHeight: 6,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }
      ),
    );
  }
}

## lib/features/pipeline/presentation/ai_scheduler_controller.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/presentation/ai_scheduler_controller.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../core/constants/app_constants.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../../../core/network/dio_provider.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/cancellation_token.dart';
import '../../audio/data/pcm_audio_extractor.dart';
import '../../audio/data/vad_engine.dart';
import '../../settings/data/model_manager_repository.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../../subtitles/data/subtitle_repository_impl.dart';
import '../../subtitles/domain/entities/subtitle_track.dart';
import '../../subtitles/domain/repositories/subtitle_repository.dart';
import '../data/dubbing_repository.dart';
import '../data/local_stt_engine.dart';
import '../data/local_translation_engine.dart';
import '../data/local_tts_engine.dart';
import '../domain/ai_pipeline.dart';
import '../domain/buffer_policy.dart';
import '../domain/device_capability.dart';
import '../domain/dub_segment.dart';
import '../domain/playback_gate.dart';
import '../domain/timeline_subtitle_buffer.dart';

class _Sentinel {
  const _Sentinel();
}

const _keep = _Sentinel();

class AiSchedulerState {
  const AiSchedulerState({
    required this.playbackPosition,
    required this.subtitleReadyUntil,
    required this.dubReadyUntil,
    required this.workMode,
    required this.activeSourceStrategy,
    this.activeSegment,
    this.isBufferingForAi = false,
    this.playbackRate = 1.0,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final Duration playbackPosition;
  final Duration subtitleReadyUntil;
  final Duration dubReadyUntil;
  final AiWorkMode workMode;
  final String activeSourceStrategy;
  final TimedTextSegment? activeSegment;
  final bool isBufferingForAi;
  final double playbackRate;
  final String? errorMessage;

  Duration get subtitleAhead => subtitleReadyUntil - playbackPosition;

  AiBufferSnapshot get snapshot => AiBufferSnapshot(
    playbackPosition: playbackPosition,
    subtitleReadyUntil: subtitleReadyUntil,
    dubReadyUntil: dubReadyUntil,
  );

  AiSchedulerState copyWith({
    Duration? playbackPosition,
    Duration? subtitleReadyUntil,
    Duration? dubReadyUntil,
    AiWorkMode? workMode,
    String? activeSourceStrategy,
    Object? activeSegment = _keep,
    bool? isBufferingForAi,
    double? playbackRate,
    Object? errorMessage = _keep,
  }) {
    return AiSchedulerState(
      playbackPosition: playbackPosition ?? this.playbackPosition,
      subtitleReadyUntil: subtitleReadyUntil ?? this.subtitleReadyUntil,
      dubReadyUntil: dubReadyUntil ?? this.dubReadyUntil,
      workMode: workMode ?? this.workMode,
      activeSourceStrategy: activeSourceStrategy ?? this.activeSourceStrategy,
      activeSegment: identical(activeSegment, _keep)
          ? this.activeSegment
          : activeSegment as TimedTextSegment?,
      isBufferingForAi: isBufferingForAi ?? this.isBufferingForAi,
      playbackRate: playbackRate ?? this.playbackRate,
      errorMessage: identical(errorMessage, _keep)
          ? this.errorMessage
          : errorMessage as String?,
    );
  }
}

class AiSchedulerController extends StateNotifier<AiSchedulerState> {
  AiSchedulerController({
    required SubtitleRepository subtitleRepository,
    required SpeechToTextEngine sttEngine,
    required TranslationEngine translationEngine,
    required TextToSpeechEngine ttsEngine,
    required PcmAudioExtractor audioExtractor,
    required VoiceActivityDetector vadEngine,
    required DubbingRepository dubbingRepository,
    required DiagnosticsService diagnostics,
    DeviceCapabilityProfile? deviceProfile,
  }) : _subtitleRepository = subtitleRepository,
       _sttEngine = sttEngine,
       _translationEngine = translationEngine,
       _ttsEngine = ttsEngine,
       _audioExtractor = audioExtractor,
       _vadEngine = vadEngine,
       _dubbingRepository = dubbingRepository,
       _diagnostics = diagnostics,
       _deviceProfile = deviceProfile ?? DeviceCapabilityProfile.defaultProfile,
       super(
         const AiSchedulerState(
           playbackPosition: Duration.zero,
           subtitleReadyUntil: Duration.zero,
           dubReadyUntil: Duration.zero,
           workMode: AiWorkMode.starting,
           activeSourceStrategy: 'Initializing...',
         ),
       );

  final SubtitleRepository _subtitleRepository;
  final SpeechToTextEngine _sttEngine;
  final TranslationEngine _translationEngine;
  final TextToSpeechEngine _ttsEngine;
  final PcmAudioExtractor _audioExtractor;
  final VoiceActivityDetector _vadEngine;
  final DubbingRepository _dubbingRepository;
  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;
  final DeviceCapabilityProfile _deviceProfile;

  final TimelineSubtitleBuffer _timelineBuffer = TimelineSubtitleBuffer();
  final _policy = const AiBufferPolicy();
  final _playbackGate = const PlaybackGate();

  int _generation = 0;
  CancellationToken? _activeToken;
  ResolvedSource? activeSource;

  Future<void> initializeForSource(ResolvedSource source) async {
    final gen = _beginNewSession();
    activeSource = source;
    _timelineBuffer.clear();
    _dubbingRepository.clear();
    state = state.copyWith(errorMessage: null);

    _diagnostics.log(
      'AIScheduler',
      'Initializing for source: ${source.kind.name}',
    );

    try {
      if (source.manualSubtitlePath != null) {
        state = state.copyWith(
          activeSourceStrategy: 'Using Manual Subtitle File',
        );
        final manualTrack = SubtitleTrack(
          id: 'manual_sub',
          language: 'unknown',
          title: 'Manual Subtitle',
          uri: Uri.file(source.manualSubtitlePath!),
          format: source.manualSubtitlePath!.toLowerCase().endsWith('.vtt')
              ? SubtitleFormat.webvtt
              : SubtitleFormat.srt,
          isTargetLanguage: false,
        );
        await _loadSubtitleTrack(manualTrack, gen, translate: true);
        return;
      }

      final tracks = await _subtitleRepository.findSubtitleTracks(source);
      if (_isStale(gen)) return;

      final viTrack = tracks
          .where((t) => t.isTargetLanguage || t.language.toLowerCase() == 'vi')
          .firstOrNull;

      if (viTrack != null) {
        state = state.copyWith(
          activeSourceStrategy: 'Using Existing Vietnamese Subtitles',
        );
        await _loadSubtitleTrack(viTrack, gen, translate: false);
        return;
      }

      final foreignTrack = tracks.firstOrNull;
      if (foreignTrack != null) {
        state = state.copyWith(
          activeSourceStrategy:
              'Translating ${foreignTrack.language.toUpperCase()} Subtitles',
        );
        await _loadSubtitleTrack(foreignTrack, gen, translate: true);
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(
        activeSourceStrategy: 'AI Pipeline (VAD -> STT -> Translation)',
      );
      await _runAudioSttPipeline(source, gen, startAt: state.playbackPosition);
    } on OperationCancelledException {
      _diagnostics.log('AIScheduler', 'Pipeline cancelled for gen $gen');
    } catch (e, st) {
      if (_isStale(gen)) return;
      final msg = e.toString().contains('model not found')
          ? 'Lỗi: Thiếu model AI. Vui lòng tải xuống trong Cài đặt.'
          : 'Không thể khởi tạo phụ đề tự động: $e';

      _diagnostics.log(
        'AIScheduler',
        'Init failed: $e\n$st',
        level: LogLevel.error,
      );
      state = state.copyWith(errorMessage: msg, workMode: AiWorkMode.blocked);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadSubtitleTrack(
    SubtitleTrack track,
    int gen, {
    required bool translate,
  }) async {
    final raw = await _subtitleRepository.fetchSubtitleSegments(track);
    if (_isStale(gen)) return;

    final startIndex = raw.indexWhere((s) => s.end >= state.playbackPosition);
    final startAt = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex;

    for (var i = startAt; i < raw.length; i += 20) {
      if (_isStale(gen)) return;
      await _waitUntilBufferNeeded(gen);
      if (_isStale(gen)) return;

      final batch = raw.skip(i).take(20).toList();
      final processedBatch = translate
          ? await _translationEngine.translate(
              batch,
              targetLanguage: AppConstants.targetLanguage,
            )
          : batch;

      if (_isStale(gen)) return;
      _timelineBuffer.addSegments(processedBatch);
      unawaited(_synthesizeBatch(processedBatch, gen));
      _updateBufferState();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _synthesizeBatch(
    List<TimedTextSegment> segments,
    int gen,
  ) async {
    for (final seg in segments) {
      if (_isStale(gen)) return;
      final targetDuration = seg.end - seg.start;
      try {
        final audio = await _ttsEngine.synthesize(
          seg.text,
          targetDuration: targetDuration,
        );
        if (_isStale(gen)) return;

        final dubSeg = DubSegment(
          id: 'dub_${seg.start.inMilliseconds}',
          startPts: seg.start,
          endPts: seg.end,
          sourceText: '',
          translatedText: seg.text,
          generatedAudio: audio,
          generatedDuration: targetDuration,
          targetDuration: targetDuration,
          voiceId: 'vi_female',
          modelVersion: '1.0',
        );

        _dubbingRepository.addSegment(dubSeg);
        _updateBufferState();
      } catch (e) {
        _diagnostics.log('AIScheduler', 'TTS failed for segment: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _runAudioSttPipeline(
    ResolvedSource source,
    int gen, {
    required Duration startAt,
  }) async {
    final token = _activeToken!;
    final audioStream = _audioExtractor.extractPcmStream(
      source,
      startPosition: startAt,
    );

    await for (final speech in _vadEngine.detectSpeech(
      audioStream,
      onProgress: (pts) {
        if (_isStale(gen)) return;
        _timelineBuffer.reportProgress(pts);
        _updateBufferState();
      },
    )) {
      token.throwIfCancelled();
      if (_isStale(gen)) return;
      await _waitUntilBufferNeeded(gen);
      if (_isStale(gen)) return;

      final chunkStream = Stream<PcmChunk>.fromIterable(speech.chunks);
      final sttSegments = await _sttEngine.transcribe(chunkStream);

      final translated = await _translationEngine.translate(
        sttSegments,
        targetLanguage: AppConstants.targetLanguage,
      );

      if (_isStale(gen)) return;
      _timelineBuffer.addSegments(translated);
      unawaited(_synthesizeBatch(translated, gen));
      _updateBufferState();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _waitUntilBufferNeeded(int gen) async {
    while (!_isStale(gen) &&
        (_timelineBuffer.subtitleReadyUntil - state.playbackPosition) >
            const Duration(minutes: 2)) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
    }
  }

  int _beginNewSession() {
    _activeToken?.cancel();
    _activeToken = CancellationToken();
    return ++_generation;
  }

  bool _isStale(int gen) => !mounted || gen != _generation;

  void updatePlaybackPosition(Duration pts) {
    // Tự động giải phóng các cue phụ đề quá hạn 60s
    _timelineBuffer.pruneObsolete(pts);

    final activeSeg = _timelineBuffer.segmentAt(pts);
    final dubSeg = _dubbingRepository.getSegmentAt(pts);
    if (dubSeg != null) {
      _dubbingRepository.markAsActive(dubSeg.id);
    }

    final snapshot = AiBufferSnapshot(
      playbackPosition: pts,
      subtitleReadyUntil: _timelineBuffer.subtitleReadyUntil,
      dubReadyUntil: _dubbingRepository.dubReadyUntil,
    );

    final decision = _playbackGate.evaluate(
      snapshot: snapshot,
      playbackRate: state.playbackRate,
      isUserPaused: false,
    );

    state = state.copyWith(
      playbackPosition: pts,
      subtitleReadyUntil: _timelineBuffer.subtitleReadyUntil,
      dubReadyUntil: _dubbingRepository.dubReadyUntil,
      workMode: decision.workMode,
      activeSegment: activeSeg,
      isBufferingForAi: !decision.shouldPlay,
    );
  }

  void handleSeek(Duration newPts) {
    final gen = _beginNewSession();
    _timelineBuffer.flushObsolete(newPts);
    _dubbingRepository.clear();
    updatePlaybackPosition(newPts);

    final source = activeSource;
    if (source != null && state.activeSourceStrategy.contains('AI Pipeline')) {
      unawaited(_runAudioSttPipeline(source, gen, startAt: newPts));
    }
  }

  void updatePlaybackRate(double rate) {
    state = state.copyWith(playbackRate: rate);
    _updateBufferState();
  }

  void _updateBufferState() {
    final readyUntil = _timelineBuffer.subtitleReadyUntil;
    final dubReadyUntil = _dubbingRepository.dubReadyUntil;

    final snapshot = AiBufferSnapshot(
      playbackPosition: state.playbackPosition,
      subtitleReadyUntil: readyUntil,
      dubReadyUntil: dubReadyUntil,
    );

    final canStart = _policy.canStart(
      snapshot,
      deviceProfile: _deviceProfile,
      playbackRate: state.playbackRate,
    );

    final mode = state.errorMessage != null
        ? AiWorkMode.blocked
        : _policy.modeFor(snapshot, playbackRate: state.playbackRate);

    state = state.copyWith(
      subtitleReadyUntil: readyUntil,
      dubReadyUntil: dubReadyUntil,
      workMode: mode,
      isBufferingForAi:
          !canStart &&
          (state.playbackPosition == Duration.zero || state.isBufferingForAi),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _activeToken?.cancel();
    _generation++;
    super.dispose();
  }
}

// Providers
final subtitleRepositoryProvider = Provider<SubtitleRepository>((ref) {
  return SubtitleRepositoryImpl(ref.watch(dioProvider));
});

final sttEngineProvider = Provider<SpeechToTextEngine>((ref) {
  return LocalSpeechToTextEngine(
    ref.watch(modelManagerRepositoryProvider),
    ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider),
  );
});

final translationEngineProvider = Provider<TranslationEngine>((ref) {
  return LocalTranslationEngine(
    ref.watch(modelManagerRepositoryProvider),
    ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider),
  );
});

final ttsEngineProvider = Provider<TextToSpeechEngine>((ref) {
  return LocalTextToSpeechEngine(
    ref.watch(modelManagerRepositoryProvider),
    ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider),
  );
});

final pcmAudioExtractorProvider = Provider<PcmAudioExtractor>((ref) {
  if (Platform.isAndroid) {
    return NativePcmAudioExtractor(ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider));
  }
  return const DefaultPcmAudioExtractor();
});

final vadEngineProvider = Provider<VoiceActivityDetector>((ref) {
  return LocalVadEngine(
    ref.watch(modelManagerRepositoryProvider),
    ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider),
  );
});

final dubbingRepositoryProvider = Provider<DubbingRepository>((ref) {
  return DubbingRepository();
});

final activeDubIdProvider = StreamProvider.autoDispose<String?>((ref) {
  return ref.watch(dubbingRepositoryProvider).activeIdStream;
});

final aiSchedulerProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider.autoDispose<AiSchedulerController, AiSchedulerState>((
      ref,
    ) {
      return AiSchedulerController(
        subtitleRepository: ref.watch(subtitleRepositoryProvider),
        sttEngine: ref.watch(sttEngineProvider),
        translationEngine: ref.watch(translationEngineProvider),
        ttsEngine: ref.watch(ttsEngineProvider),
        audioExtractor: ref.watch(pcmAudioExtractorProvider),
        vadEngine: ref.watch(vadEngineProvider),
        dubbingRepository: ref.watch(dubbingRepositoryProvider),
        diagnostics: ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider),
      );
    });

## lib/features/pipeline/presentation/dubbing_controller.dart
```dart:lib/features/pipeline/presentation/dubbing_controller.dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:audioplayers/audioplayers.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../data/dubbing_repository.dart';
import 'ai_scheduler_controller.dart';

class DubbingController extends StateNotifier<bool> {
  DubbingController({required DubbingRepository repository, required this.ref})
    : _repository = repository,
      super(true) {
    _init();
  }

  final DubbingRepository _repository;
  final Ref ref;
  final AudioPlayer _audioPlayer = AudioPlayer();
  StreamSubscription? _activeIdSub;

  void _init() {
    _activeIdSub = _repository.activeIdStream.listen((id) async {
      if (!state) return;

      if (id == null) {
        await _audioPlayer.stop();
        return;
      }

      final segment = _repository.getSegmentAt(
        ref.read(aiSchedulerProvider).playbackPosition,
      );
      if (segment != null) {
        await _playSegmentInMemory(segment.generatedAudio);
      }
    });
  }

  /// Phát trực tiếp dữ liệu âm thanh từ RAM bằng BytesSource, triệt tiêu I/O đĩa
  Future<void> _playSegmentInMemory(List<int> audioData) async {
    try {
      final wavData = Uint8List.fromList(_addWavHeader(audioData, 16000));
      await _audioPlayer.play(
        BytesSource(wavData),
        mode: PlayerMode.lowLatency,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      ref
          .read(diagnosticsServiceProvider)
          .log('Dubbing', 'InMemory Play error: $e', level: LogLevel.error);
    }
  }

  List<int> _addWavHeader(List<int> pcmData, int sampleRate) {
    final int fileSize = pcmData.length + 36;
    final ByteData header = ByteData(44);

    header.setUint8(0, 0x52); // R
    header.setUint8(1, 0x49); // I
    header.setUint8(2, 0x46); // F
    header.setUint8(3, 0x46); // F
    header.setUint32(4, fileSize, Endian.little);
    header.setUint8(8, 0x57); // W
    header.setUint8(9, 0x41); // A
    header.setUint8(10, 0x56); // V
    header.setUint8(11, 0x45); // E

    // fmt chunk
    header.setUint8(12, 0x66); // f
    header.setUint8(13, 0x6D); // m
    header.setUint8(14, 0x74); // t
    header.setUint8(15, 0x20); //
    header.setUint32(16, 16, Endian.little); // Chunk size
    header.setUint16(20, 1, Endian.little); // PCM format
    header.setUint16(22, 1, Endian.little); // Mono
    header.setUint32(24, sampleRate, Endian.little);
    header.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, Endian.little); // Byte rate
    header.setUint16(32, 2, Endian.little); // Block align
    header.setUint16(34, 16, Endian.little); // Bits per sample

    // data chunk
    header.setUint8(36, 0x64); // d
    header.setUint8(37, 0x61); // a
    header.setUint8(38, 0x74); // t
    header.setUint8(39, 0x61); // a
    header.setUint32(40, pcmData.length, Endian.little);

    return header.buffer.asUint8List().toList() + pcmData;
  }

  void toggleDubbing() {
    state = !state;
    if (!state) _audioPlayer.stop();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _activeIdSub?.cancel();
    _audioPlayer.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

final dubbingControllerProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<DubbingController, bool>((ref) {
      return DubbingController(
        repository: ref.watch(dubbingRepositoryProvider),
        ref: ref,
      );
    });

import 'dart:async';

enum AudioCaptureState { idle, requestingConsent, active, denied, error }

class EmbeddedAudioCaptureManager {
  AudioCaptureState _state = AudioCaptureState.idle;
  final _stateController = StreamController<AudioCaptureState>.broadcast();

  AudioCaptureState get state => _state;
  Stream<AudioCaptureState> get stateStream => _stateController.stream;

  /// Requests explicit user consent for Android playback audio capture (MediaProjection / AudioPlaybackCapture).
  /// Never invoked on app startup; only on explicit user request after native migration failure.
  Future<bool> requestConsentAndStartCapture() async {
    _updateState(AudioCaptureState.requestingConsent);

    try {
      // Simulate Android MediaProjection / AudioPlaybackCapture consent flow
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));

      // In production Android, this invokes MediaProjectionManager.createScreenCaptureIntent()
      // and AudioPlaybackCaptureConfiguration.
      _updateState(AudioCaptureState.active);
      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      _updateState(AudioCaptureState.denied);
      return false;
    }
  }

  void stopCapture() {
    _updateState(AudioCaptureState.idle);
  }

  void _updateState(AudioCaptureState newState) {
    _state = newState;
    if (!_stateController.isClosed) {
      _stateController.add(_state);
    }
  }

  void dispose() {
    _stateController.close();
  }
}

## lib/features/player/data/migration_controller.dart
```dart:lib/features/player/data/migration_controller.dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:local_ai_video_translator/core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import 'package:local_ai_video_translator/features/source_resolver/data/candidate_verifier.dart';
import 'package:local_ai_video_translator/features/source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';

import '../domain/entities/migration_state.dart';
import '../domain/entities/player_state.dart';
import 'native_media_session.dart';

class NativeMigrationController {
  NativeMigrationController(
    this._nativeSession,
    this._verifier,
    this._diagnostics,
  );

  final NativeMediaSession _nativeSession;
  final CandidateVerifier _verifier;
  final DiagnosticsService _diagnostics;

  MigrationStatus _status = MigrationStatus.embedded;
  final _statusController = StreamController<MigrationStatus>.broadcast();

  MigrationStatus get status => _status;
  Stream<MigrationStatus> get statusStream => _statusController.stream;

  Future<NativeMigrationResult> attemptMigration({
    required ResolvedSource source,
    Duration? capturedPosition,
  }) async {
    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();
    _updateStatus(MigrationStatus.validatingCandidate);
    _diagnostics.log(
      'MigrationController',
      'Beginning candidate verification before native migration for ${source.finalUri}',
    );

    try {
      // Step 1: Validate candidate accessibility
      final candidate =
          source.selectedCandidate ?? source.candidates.firstOrNull;

      if (candidate != null) {
        final verification = await _verifier.verify(candidate);
        if (!verification.isAccessible) {
          throw NativePlayerBackendException(
            'Candidate ${candidate.uri} failed verification: ${verification.error ?? 'HTTP ${verification.statusCode}'}',
          );
        }
      }

      // Step 2: Prepare native player session while keeping embedded view active
      _updateStatus(MigrationStatus.preparingNative);
      _diagnostics.log(
        'MigrationController',
        'Candidate verified accessible. Opening native media session.',
      );

      await _nativeSession.open(source);

      if (_nativeSession.currentSnapshot.status == PlayerStatus.error) {
        throw _nativeSession.currentSnapshot.error ??
            const NativePlayerBackendException(
              'Native player encountered error during preparation',
            );
      }

      _updateStatus(MigrationStatus.nativeReady);

      // Step 3: Seek to captured webview position if applicable
      if (capturedPosition != null && capturedPosition > Duration.zero) {
        _diagnostics.log(
          'MigrationController',
          'Seeking native player to captured position: $capturedPosition',
        );
        await _nativeSession.seek(capturedPosition);
      }

      // Step 4: Switch UI playback mode and confirm completion
      stopwatch.stop();
      _updateStatus(MigrationStatus.switchedToNative);
      _diagnostics.log(
        'MigrationController',
        'Successfully migrated to native player in ${stopwatch.elapsed.inMilliseconds}ms',
      );

      return NativeMigrationResult(
        status: MigrationStatus.switchedToNative,
        attemptedCandidateUri: source.finalUri,
        capturedPosition: capturedPosition ?? Duration.zero,
        prepareDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      stopwatch.stop();
      _diagnostics.log(
        'MigrationController',
        'Native migration failed: $e. Reverting to embedded WebView.',
        level: LogLevel.warning,
      );
      await _nativeSession.close();

      _updateStatus(MigrationStatus.nativeFailedReverted);

      return NativeMigrationResult(
        status: MigrationStatus.nativeFailedReverted,
        attemptedCandidateUri: source.finalUri,
        capturedPosition: capturedPosition ?? Duration.zero,
        prepareDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,
        failureReason: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  void _updateStatus(MigrationStatus newStatus) {
    _status = newStatus;
    if (!_statusController.isClosed) {
      _statusController.add(_status);
    }
  }

  void dispose() {
    _statusController.close();
  }
}

## lib/features/player/data/native_media_session.dart
```dart:lib/features/player/data/native_media_session.dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:media_kit/media_kit.dart' as mk;

import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_session_snapshot.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_track.dart';
import '../domain/entities/player_state.dart';
import '../domain/services/media_session.dart';
import 'player_diagnostics.dart';

class NativeMediaSession implements MediaSession {
  NativeMediaSession([PlayerDiagnostics? diagnostics])
    : _diagnostics = diagnostics ?? PlayerDiagnostics();

  final PlayerDiagnostics _diagnostics;
  mk.Player? _player;

  MediaSessionSnapshot _snapshot = MediaSessionSnapshot.idle;
  final _snapshotController =
      StreamController<MediaSessionSnapshot>.broadcast();

  final List<StreamSubscription<dynamic>> _subscriptions = [];

  mk.Player? get player => _player;

  @override
  MediaSessionSnapshot get currentSnapshot => _snapshot;

  @override
  Stream<MediaSessionSnapshot> get snapshotStream => _snapshotController.stream;

  PlayerDiagnostics get diagnostics => _diagnostics;

  @override
  Future<void> open(ResolvedSource source) async {
    final prepareStopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();
    await close();

    _player = mk.Player();

    _updateSnapshot(
      MediaSessionSnapshot.idle.copyWith(
        mediaIdentity: source.finalUri.toString(),
        status: PlayerStatus.initializing,
        requestContext: source.requestContext,
      ),
    );

    // Bind player event streams
    _subscriptions.addAll([
      _player!.stream.position.listen((pos) {
        _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(position: pos));
      }),
      _player!.stream.duration.listen((dur) {
        _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(duration: dur));
      }),
      _player!.stream.buffer.listen((buf) {
        _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(buffered: buf));
      }),
      _player!.stream.playing.listen((playing) {
        _updateSnapshot(
          _snapshot.copyWith(
            status: playing ? PlayerStatus.playing : PlayerStatus.paused,
          ),
        );
      }),
      _player!.stream.buffering.listen((buffering) {
        if (buffering) {
          _diagnostics.incrementBufferEvents();
          _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(status: PlayerStatus.buffering));
        }
      }),
      _player!.stream.completed.listen((completed) {
        if (completed) {
          _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(status: PlayerStatus.ended));
        }
      }),
      _player!.stream.rate.listen((rate) {
        _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(playbackRate: rate));
      }),
      _player!.stream.tracks.listen((tracks) {
        _enumerateTracks(tracks);
      }),
      _player!.stream.error.listen((errorStr) {
        if (errorStr.isNotEmpty) {
          final err = NativePlayerBackendException('MediaKit error: $errorStr');
          _diagnostics.recordError(err.toString());
          _updateSnapshot(
            _snapshot.copyWith(status: PlayerStatus.error, error: err),
          );
        }
      }),
    ]);

    try {
      // Pass isolated request context headers to media_kit
      final media = mk.Media(
        source.finalUri.toString(),
        httpHeaders: source.requestContext.headers,
      );

      await _player!.open(media, play: false);

      prepareStopwatch.stop();
      _diagnostics.recordPrepareDuration(prepareStopwatch.elapsed);

      _updateSnapshot(
        _snapshot.copyWith(
          status: PlayerStatus.ready,
          duration: _player!.state.duration,
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      prepareStopwatch.stop();
      final err = PlaybackInitializationException(
        'Could not initialize native media playback',
        e,
      );
      _diagnostics.recordError(err.toString());
      _updateSnapshot(
        _snapshot.copyWith(status: PlayerStatus.error, error: err),
      );
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  void _enumerateTracks(mk.Tracks tracks) {
    final videoList = <VideoTrack>[];
    final audioList = <AudioTrack>[];
    final subtitleList = <PlayerSubtitleTrack>[];

    for (var i = 0; i < tracks.video.length; i++) {
      final vt = tracks.video[i];
      videoList.add(
        VideoTrack(
          id: vt.id,
          label: vt.title ?? 'Video Stream #${i + 1}',
          language: vt.language,
          codec: vt.codec,
        ),
      );
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < tracks.audio.length; i++) {
      final at = tracks.audio[i];
      final channelCount = int.tryParse(at.channels ?? '');
      audioList.add(
        AudioTrack(
          id: at.id,
          label: at.title ?? 'Audio Stream #${i + 1}',
          language: at.language,
          channels: channelCount,
          codec: at.codec,
          isDefault: i == 0,
        ),
      );
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < tracks.subtitle.length; i++) {
      final st = tracks.subtitle[i];
      final lang = st.language ?? 'unknown';
      subtitleList.add(
        PlayerSubtitleTrack(
          id: st.id,
          label: st.title ?? 'Subtitle #${i + 1} ($lang)',
          language: lang,
          isEmbedded: true,
          classification: PlayerSubtitleTrack.classify(lang),
        ),
      );
    }

    final trackSet = MediaTrackSet(
      videoTracks: List.unmodifiable(videoList),
      audioTracks: List.unmodifiable(audioList),
      subtitleTracks: List.unmodifiable(subtitleList),
    );

    _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(trackSet: trackSet));
  }

  @override
  Future<void> play() async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    await _player!.play();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> pause() async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    await _player!.pause();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> seek(Duration position) async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(status: PlayerStatus.seeking));
    await _player!.seek(position);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> setPlaybackRate(double rate) async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    await _player!.setRate(rate);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> selectVideoTrack(VideoTrack track) async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    final mkTrack = _player!.state.tracks.video.firstWhere(
      (t) => t.id == track.id,
      orElse: () => _player!.state.tracks.video.first,
    );
    await _player!.setVideoTrack(mkTrack);
    _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(activeVideoTrack: track));
  }

  @override
  Future<void> selectAudioTrack(AudioTrack track) async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    final mkTrack = _player!.state.tracks.audio.firstWhere(
      (t) => t.id == track.id,
      orElse: () => _player!.state.tracks.audio.first,
    );
    await _player!.setAudioTrack(mkTrack);
    _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(activeAudioTrack: track));
  }

  @override
  Future<void> selectSubtitleTrack(PlayerSubtitleTrack? track) async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    if (track == null) {
      await _player!.setSubtitleTrack(mk.SubtitleTrack.no());
      _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(activeSubtitleTrack: null));
    } else {
      final mkTrack = _player!.state.tracks.subtitle.firstWhere(
        (t) => t.id == track.id,
        orElse: () => _player!.state.tracks.subtitle.first,
      );
      await _player!.setSubtitleTrack(mkTrack);
      _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(activeSubtitleTrack: track));
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> setVolume(double volume) async {
    if (_player == null) return;
    await _player!.setVolume(volume);
    _updateSnapshot(_snapshot.copyWith(volume: volume));
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    for (final sub in _subscriptions) {
      await sub.cancel();
    }
    _subscriptions.clear();

    if (_player != null) {
      await _player!.dispose();
      _player = null;
    }

    _diagnostics.reset();
    _updateSnapshot(MediaSessionSnapshot.idle);
  }

  void _updateSnapshot(MediaSessionSnapshot newSnapshot) {
    _snapshot = newSnapshot;
    if (!_snapshotController.isClosed) {
      _snapshotController.add(_snapshot);
    }
  }
}

## lib/features/player/data/player_diagnostics.dart
```dart:lib/features/player/data/player_diagnostics.dart
import 'dart:async';

class PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics {
  const PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics({
    this.prepareDuration = Duration.zero,
    this.bufferEventCount = 0,
    this.droppedFrameCount = 0,
    this.decoderInfo = 'Software/Hardware Default',
    this.bandwidthEstimate = 0,
    this.lastError,
  });

  final Duration prepareDuration;
  final int bufferEventCount;
  final int droppedFrameCount;
  final String decoderInfo;
  final int bandwidthEstimate; // bits per second
  final String? lastError;

  PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics copyWith({
    Duration? prepareDuration,
    int? bufferEventCount,
    int? droppedFrameCount,
    String? decoderInfo,
    int? bandwidthEstimate,
    String? lastError,
  }) {
    return PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics(
      prepareDuration: prepareDuration ?? this.prepareDuration,
      bufferEventCount: bufferEventCount ?? this.bufferEventCount,
      droppedFrameCount: droppedFrameCount ?? this.droppedFrameCount,
      decoderInfo: decoderInfo ?? this.decoderInfo,
      bandwidthEstimate: bandwidthEstimate ?? this.bandwidthEstimate,
      lastError: lastError ?? this.lastError,
    );
  }
}

class PlayerDiagnostics {
  PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics _metrics = const PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics();
  final _controller = StreamController<PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics>.broadcast();

  PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics get metrics => _metrics;
  Stream<PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics> get stream => _controller.stream;

  void recordPrepareDuration(Duration duration) {
    _metrics = _metrics.copyWith(prepareDuration: duration);
    _controller.add(_metrics);
  }

  void incrementBufferEvents() {
    _metrics = _metrics.copyWith(
      bufferEventCount: _metrics.bufferEventCount + 1,
    );
    _controller.add(_metrics);
  }

  void updateDroppedFrames(int count) {
    _metrics = _metrics.copyWith(droppedFrameCount: count);
    _controller.add(_metrics);
  }

  void updateDecoderInfo(String info) {
    _metrics = _metrics.copyWith(decoderInfo: info);
    _controller.add(_metrics);
  }

  void updateBandwidthEstimate(int bps) {
    _metrics = _metrics.copyWith(bandwidthEstimate: bps);
    _controller.add(_metrics);
  }

  void recordError(String error) {
    _metrics = _metrics.copyWith(lastError: error);
    _controller.add(_metrics);
  }

  void reset() {
    _metrics = const PlayerDiagnosticsMetrics();
    _controller.add(_metrics);
  }

  void dispose() {
    _controller.close();
  }
}

class EmbeddedCapabilityProbe {
  const EmbeddedCapabilityProbe({
    required this.canPlay,
    required this.canPause,
    required this.canReadPosition,
    required this.canObserveSeek,
    required this.canAccessAudio,
  });

  final bool canPlay;
  final bool canPause;
  final bool canReadPosition;
  final bool canObserveSeek;
  final bool canAccessAudio;

  bool get isEmbeddedAiSupported =>
      canPlay &&
      canPause &&
      canReadPosition &&
      canObserveSeek &&
      canAccessAudio;

  static const unsupported = EmbeddedCapabilityProbe(
    canPlay: false,
    canPause: false,
    canReadPosition: false,
    canObserveSeek: false,
    canAccessAudio: false,
  );

  static const standardWeb = EmbeddedCapabilityProbe(
    canPlay: true,
    canPause: true,
    canReadPosition: true,
    canObserveSeek: true,
    canAccessAudio:
        false, // Requires explicit user audio capture permission consent
  );
}

import '../../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import 'media_track.dart';
import 'migration_state.dart';
import 'player_state.dart';

class MediaSessionSnapshot {
  const MediaSessionSnapshot({
    required this.mediaIdentity,
    required this.duration,
    required this.position,
    required this.buffered,
    required this.status,
    required this.playbackRate,
    this.volume = 100.0,
    this.activeVideoTrack,
    this.activeAudioTrack,
    this.activeSubtitleTrack,
    this.trackSet = MediaTrackSet.empty,
    this.requestContext = RequestContext.defaultContext,
    this.error,
    this.migrationStatus = MigrationStatus.embedded,
  });

  final String mediaIdentity;
  final Duration duration;
  final Duration position;
  final Duration buffered;
  final PlayerStatus status;
  final double playbackRate;
  final double volume;
  final VideoTrack? activeVideoTrack;
  final AudioTrack? activeAudioTrack;
  final PlayerSubtitleTrack? activeSubtitleTrack;
  final MediaTrackSet trackSet;
  final RequestContext requestContext;
  final PlayerError? error;
  final MigrationStatus migrationStatus;

  bool get isPlaying => status == PlayerStatus.playing;
  bool get isPaused => status == PlayerStatus.paused;
  bool get isBuffering => status == PlayerStatus.buffering;
  bool get isCompleted => status == PlayerStatus.ended;
  bool get isReady =>
      status == PlayerStatus.ready ||
      status == PlayerStatus.playing ||
      status == PlayerStatus.paused;

  MediaSessionSnapshot copyWith({
    String? mediaIdentity,
    Duration? duration,
    Duration? position,
    Duration? buffered,
    PlayerStatus? status,
    double? playbackRate,
    double? volume,
    VideoTrack? activeVideoTrack,
    AudioTrack? activeAudioTrack,
    PlayerSubtitleTrack? activeSubtitleTrack,
    MediaTrackSet? trackSet,
    RequestContext? requestContext,
    PlayerError? error,
    MigrationStatus? migrationStatus,
  }) {
    return MediaSessionSnapshot(
      mediaIdentity: mediaIdentity ?? this.mediaIdentity,
      duration: duration ?? this.duration,
      position: position ?? this.position,
      buffered: buffered ?? this.buffered,
      status: status ?? this.status,
      playbackRate: playbackRate ?? this.playbackRate,
      volume: volume ?? this.volume,
      activeVideoTrack: activeVideoTrack ?? this.activeVideoTrack,
      activeAudioTrack: activeAudioTrack ?? this.activeAudioTrack,
      activeSubtitleTrack: activeSubtitleTrack ?? this.activeSubtitleTrack,
      trackSet: trackSet ?? this.trackSet,
      requestContext: requestContext ?? this.requestContext,
      error: error ?? this.error,
      migrationStatus: migrationStatus ?? this.migrationStatus,
    );
  }

  static const idle = MediaSessionSnapshot(
    mediaIdentity: '',
    duration: Duration.zero,
    position: Duration.zero,
    buffered: Duration.zero,
    status: PlayerStatus.idle,
    playbackRate: 1.0,
    volume: 100.0,
  );
}

class AudioTrack {
  const AudioTrack({
    required this.id,
    required this.label,
    this.language,
    this.channels,
    this.sampleRate,
    this.codec,
    this.isSelected = false,
    this.isDefault = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final String label;
  final String? language;
  final int? channels;
  final int? sampleRate;
  final String? codec;
  final bool isSelected;
  final bool isDefault;

  AudioTrack copyWith({bool? isSelected}) {
    return AudioTrack(
      id: id,
      label: label,
      language: language,
      channels: channels,
      sampleRate: sampleRate,
      codec: codec,
      isSelected: isSelected ?? this.isSelected,
      isDefault: isDefault,
    );
  }
}

class PlayerSubtitleTrack {
  const PlayerSubtitleTrack({
    required this.id,
    required this.label,
    required this.language,
    this.format,
    this.uri,
    this.isEmbedded = false,
    this.isSelected = false,
    required this.classification,
  });

  final String id;
  final String label;
  final String language;
  final String? format;
  final Uri? uri;
  final bool isEmbedded;
  final bool isSelected;
  final SubtitleClassification classification;

  static SubtitleClassification classify(String lang) {
    final lower = lang.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (lower == 'vi' || lower == 'vietnamese' || lower == 'vie') {
      return SubtitleClassification.vietnamese;
    }
    if (lower == 'en' ||
        lower == 'english' ||
        lower == 'ja' ||
        lower == 'japanese' ||
        lower == 'zh' ||
        lower == 'chinese') {
      return SubtitleClassification.sourceLanguage;
    }
    return SubtitleClassification.unknownOther;
  }

  PlayerSubtitleTrack copyWith({bool? isSelected}) {
    return PlayerSubtitleTrack(
      id: id,
      label: label,
      language: language,
      format: format,
      uri: uri,
      isEmbedded: isEmbedded,
      isSelected: isSelected ?? this.isSelected,
      classification: classification,
    );
  }
}

class MediaTrackSet {
  const MediaTrackSet({
    this.videoTracks = const [],
    this.audioTracks = const [],
    this.subtitleTracks = const [],
  });

  final List<VideoTrack> videoTracks;
  final List<AudioTrack> audioTracks;
  final List<PlayerSubtitleTrack> subtitleTracks;

  static const empty = MediaTrackSet();
}

sealed class PlayerError implements Exception {
  const PlayerError(this.message, [this.cause]);
  final String message;
  final Object? cause;

  @override
  String toString() =>
      '$runtimeType: $message${cause != null ? ' ($cause)' : ''}';
}

}

## lib/features/player/presentation/embedded_player_view.dart
```dart:lib/features/player/presentation/embedded_player_view.dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:webview_flutter/webview_flutter.dart';

import '../../pipeline/presentation/ai_scheduler_controller.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/data/android_media_observer.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../data/embedded_audio_capture.dart';
import '../domain/embedded_capability.dart';
import 'media_session_controller.dart';
import 'native_player_view.dart';
import 'subtitle_overlay.dart';

class EmbeddedPlayerView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EmbeddedPlayerView({required this.source, super.key});
  final ResolvedSource source;

  @override
  ConsumerState<EmbeddedPlayerView> createState() => _EmbeddedPlayerViewState();
}

class _EmbeddedPlayerViewState extends ConsumerState<EmbeddedPlayerView> {
  final bool _isMigratedToNative = false;
  late final WebViewController _controller;
  final List<String> _runtimeCandidates = [];
  late final AndroidMediaObserver _mediaObserver;
  StreamSubscription? _observerSub;

  final EmbeddedAudioCaptureManager _audioCaptureManager =
      EmbeddedAudioCaptureManager();
  EmbeddedCapabilityProbe _capabilityProbe =
      EmbeddedCapabilityProbe.standardWeb;

  ResolvedSource? _migratedSource;
  bool _isMigrating = false;
  String? _migrationErrorMessage;
  bool _aiSubtitlesEnabled = false;
  Timer? _positionUpdateTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _mediaObserver = AndroidMediaObserver()..startObserving();
    _observerSub = _mediaObserver.candidates.listen((candidate) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        final uriStr = candidate.uri.toString();
        if (!_runtimeCandidates.contains(uriStr)) {
          _runtimeCandidates.insert(0, uriStr); // Prioritize new candidates
        }
      });
    });

    _controller = WebViewController()
      ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)
      ..addJavaScriptChannel(
        'MediaObserver',
        onMessageReceived: (message) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          final data = message.message;
          if (data.startsWith('pos:')) {
            final seconds = double.tryParse(data.substring(4)) ?? 0;
            ref
                .read(aiSchedulerProvider.notifier)
                .updatePlaybackPosition(
                  Duration(milliseconds: (seconds * 1000).toInt()),
                );
          } else {
            setState(() {
              if (!_runtimeCandidates.contains(data)) {
                _runtimeCandidates.insert(0, data);
              }
            });
          }
        },
      )
      ..setNavigationDelegate(
        NavigationDelegate(
          onPageFinished: (_) {
            _injectObserver();
            _startPositionPolling();
          },
        ),
      )
      ..loadRequest(widget.source.uri);

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      ref.read(aiSchedulerProvider.notifier).initializeForSource(widget.source);
    });
  }

  void _startPositionPolling() {
    _positionUpdateTimer?.cancel();
    _positionUpdateTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), (
      timer,
    ) {
      if (!mounted || _isMigratedToNative) {
        timer.cancel();
        return;
      }
      _controller.runJavaScript(r'''
        (function() {
          var v = document.querySelector('video');
          if (v) {
            MediaObserver.postMessage('pos:' + v.currentTime);
          }
        })();
      ''');
    });
  }

  Future<void> _injectObserver() async {
    const js = r'''
      (() => {
        const send = (value) => {
          if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length < 10) return;
          if (/\.m3u8|\.mpd|\.mp4|\.webm/i.test(value)) {
            MediaObserver.postMessage(value);
          }
        };
        document.querySelectorAll('video,source,iframe').forEach(el => send(el.src));
        const oldFetch = window.fetch;
        window.fetch = function(...args) { send(String(args[0])); return oldFetch.apply(this, args); };
        const oldOpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
        XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function(method, url, ...rest) {
          send(String(url));
          return oldOpen.call(this, method, url, ...rest);
        };
        new PerformanceObserver(list => list.getEntries().forEach(e => send(e.name)))
          .observe({entryTypes: ['resource']});
      })();
    ''';
    await _controller.runJavaScript(js);
  }

  Future<void> _startNativeMigration() async {
    setState(() {
      _isMigrating = true;
      _migrationErrorMessage = null;
    });

    final targetCandidateUri = _runtimeCandidates.isNotEmpty
        ? Uri.tryParse(_runtimeCandidates.first) ?? widget.source.finalUri
        : widget.source.finalUri;

    final candidateSource = ResolvedSource(
      input: widget.source.input,
      normalizedUri: targetCandidateUri,
      finalUri: targetCandidateUri,
      kind: _inferKind(targetCandidateUri),
      playbackMode: PlaybackMode.native,
      discoveryMethod: DiscoveryMethod.runtime,
      capability: SourceCapability.full,
      requestContext: widget.source.requestContext,
      iframeChain: widget.source.iframeChain,
    );

    final success = await ref
        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
        .attemptMigrationToNative(source: candidateSource);

    if (!mounted) return;

    if (success) {
      setState(() {
        _migratedSource = candidateSource;
        _isMigrating = false;
      });
    } else {
      final migrationStatus = ref.read(migrationControllerProvider).status;
      setState(() {
        _isMigrating = false;
        _migrationErrorMessage =
            'Migration failed (status: ${migrationStatus.name}). Retaining Embedded WebView.';
        _capabilityProbe = const EmbeddedCapabilityProbe(
          canPlay: true,
          canPause: true,
          canReadPosition: true,
          canObserveSeek: true,
          canAccessAudio: false,
        );
      });
    }
  }

  MediaKind _inferKind(Uri uri) {
    final path = uri.path.toLowerCase();
    if (path.endsWith('.m3u8')) return MediaKind.hls;
    if (path.endsWith('.mpd')) return MediaKind.dash;
    return MediaKind.progressive;
  }

  /// Explicit user action to request audio capture consent for embedded AI subtitles.
  /// Never requested on app startup.
  Future<void> _requestEmbeddedAiConsent() async {
    final granted = await _audioCaptureManager.requestConsentAndStartCapture();
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (granted) {
      setState(() {
        _aiSubtitlesEnabled = true;
        _capabilityProbe = const EmbeddedCapabilityProbe(
          canPlay: true,
          canPause: true,
          canReadPosition: true,
          canObserveSeek: true,
          canAccessAudio: true,
        );
      });
    } else {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Audio capture permission denied. Embedded AI subtitles degraded gracefully.',
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _positionUpdateTimer?.cancel();
    _observerSub?.cancel();
    _mediaObserver.dispose();
    _audioCaptureManager.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_migratedSource != null) {
      return NativePlayerView(source: _migratedSource!);
    }

    final aiState = ref.watch(aiSchedulerProvider);

    return Stack(
      children: [
        WebViewWidget(controller: _controller),
        if (_aiSubtitlesEnabled && _capabilityProbe.canAccessAudio)
          SubtitleOverlay(segment: aiState.activeSegment),

        Positioned(
          left: 12,
          right: 12,
          bottom: 12,
          child: Card(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.auto_awesome,
                        color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC),
                        size: 18,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          _migrationErrorMessage != null
                              ? 'Embedded Fallback Mode (Capabilities: Play=${_capabilityProbe.canPlay}, Audio=${_capabilityProbe.canAccessAudio})'
                              : 'Runtime Media Candidates (${_runtimeCandidates.length})',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            fontSize: 13,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (!_isMigrating &&
                          !_isMigratedToNative &&
                          _migrationErrorMessage == null)
                        FilledButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _startNativeMigration,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.play_circle_fill, size: 16),
                          label: const Text('Migrate Native'),
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12,
                              vertical: 6,
                            ),
                            textStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                          ),
                        ),
                      if (_migrationErrorMessage != null &&
                          !_aiSubtitlesEnabled)
                        FilledButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _requestEmbeddedAiConsent,
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.mic, size: 16),
                          label: const Text('Enable AI Subtitles'),
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF7C5CFC),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12,
                              vertical: 6,
                            ),
                            textStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  if (_isMigrating) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const LinearProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    const Text(
                      'Verifying candidate accessibility and preparing native player...',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.white70),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_migrationErrorMessage != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      _migrationErrorMessage!,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.orangeAccent,
                        fontSize: 11,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_aiSubtitlesEnabled) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    const Text(
                      'Embedded AI audio capture active. Synchronizing Vietnamese subtitles.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.greenAccent, fontSize: 11),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

## lib/features/player/presentation/media_session_controller.dart
```dart:lib/features/player/presentation/media_session_controller.dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/diagnostics_service.dart';
import '../../../core/network/dio_provider.dart';
import '../../pipeline/data/dubbing_player_service.dart';
import '../../pipeline/presentation/ai_scheduler_controller.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/data/candidate_verifier.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../data/migration_controller.dart';
import '../data/native_media_session.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_session_snapshot.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_track.dart';

final nativeMediaSessionProvider = Provider<NativeMediaSession>((ref) {
  final session = NativeMediaSession();
  ref.onDispose(() => unawaited(session.close()));
  return session;
});

final migrationControllerProvider = Provider<NativeMigrationController>((ref) {
  final session = ref.watch(nativeMediaSessionProvider);
  final dio = ref.watch(dioProvider);
  final verifier = CandidateVerifier(dio);
  final diagnostics = ref.watch(diagnosticsServiceProvider);

  final controller = NativeMigrationController(session, verifier, diagnostics);
  ref.onDispose(controller.dispose);
  return controller;
});

final dubbingPlayerServiceProvider = Provider<DubbingPlayerService>((ref) {
  final repo = ref.watch(dubbingRepositoryProvider);
  final service = DubbingPlayerService(repo);
  ref.onDispose(service.dispose);
  return service;
});

final mediaSessionControllerProvider =
    NotifierProvider<MediaSessionController, MediaSessionSnapshot>(
      MediaSessionController.new,
    );

class MediaSessionController extends Notifier<MediaSessionSnapshot> {
  @override
  MediaSessionSnapshot build() {
    _session = ref.watch(nativeMediaSessionProvider);
    _migrationController = ref.watch(migrationControllerProvider);
    _dubbingPlayer = ref.watch(dubbingPlayerServiceProvider);

    _subscription = _session.snapshotStream.listen((snapshot) {
      state = snapshot;
      _dubbingPlayer.syncWithPlayback(snapshot.position, snapshot.isPlaying);
    });

    _duckingSubscription = _dubbingPlayer.duckingStream.listen((shouldDuck) {
      _fadeVolume(shouldDuck ? 20.0 : 100.0);
    });

    ref.onDispose(() {
      _subscription?.cancel();
      _duckingSubscription?.cancel();
      _fadeTimer?.cancel();
    });

    return MediaSessionSnapshot.idle;
  }

  late final NativeMediaSession _session;
  late final NativeMigrationController _migrationController;
  late final DubbingPlayerService _dubbingPlayer;
  StreamSubscription<MediaSessionSnapshot>? _subscription;
  StreamSubscription<bool>? _duckingSubscription;
  Timer? _fadeTimer;

  void _fadeVolume(double targetVolume) {
    _fadeTimer?.cancel();
    final startVolume = state.volume;
    const steps = 10;
    const duration = Duration(milliseconds: 200);
    final stepDuration = Duration(
      milliseconds: duration.inMilliseconds ~/ steps,
    );
    final volumeDelta = (targetVolume - startVolume) / steps;

    int currentStep = 0;
    _fadeTimer = Timer.periodic(stepDuration, (timer) {
      currentStep++;
      final nextVolume = startVolume + (volumeDelta * currentStep);
      _session.setVolume(nextVolume.clamp(0.0, 100.0));

      if (currentStep >= steps) {
        timer.cancel();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> openSource(ResolvedSource source) async {
    await _session.open(source);
  }

  Future<void> play() => _session.play();
  Future<void> pause() => _session.pause();
  Future<void> seek(Duration position) => _session.seek(position);
  Future<void> setPlaybackRate(double rate) => _session.setPlaybackRate(rate);

  Future<void> selectVideoTrack(VideoTrack track) =>
      _session.selectVideoTrack(track);
  Future<void> selectAudioTrack(AudioTrack track) =>
      _session.selectAudioTrack(track);
  Future<void> selectSubtitleTrack(PlayerSubtitleTrack? track) =>
      _session.selectSubtitleTrack(track);

  Future<bool> attemptMigrationToNative({
    required ResolvedSource source,
    Duration? capturedPosition,
  }) async {
    final result = await _migrationController.attemptMigration(
      source: source,
      capturedPosition: capturedPosition,
    );
    return result.isSuccess;
  }
}

import '../../../core/constants/app_constants.dart';
import '../../../core/diagnostics/presentation/diagnostic_log_overlay.dart';
import '../../pipeline/presentation/ai_scheduler_controller.dart';
import '../../pipeline/presentation/dubbing_controller.dart';
import '../../source_resolver/domain/entities/resolved_source.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_session_snapshot.dart';
import '../domain/entities/media_track.dart';
import '../domain/entities/player_state.dart';
import 'media_session_controller.dart';
import 'subtitle_overlay.dart';

class NativePlayerView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const NativePlayerView({required this.source, super.key});
  final ResolvedSource source;

  @override
  ConsumerState<NativePlayerView> createState() => _NativePlayerViewState();
}

class _NativePlayerViewState extends ConsumerState<NativePlayerView> {
  VideoController? _videoController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) async {
      final ctrl = ref.read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier);
      await ctrl.openSource(widget.source);

      final session = ref.read(nativeMediaSessionProvider);
      final p = session.player;

      if (p != null && mounted) {
        final controller = VideoController(p);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _videoController = controller;
          });
        }
      }

      ref.read(aiSchedulerProvider.notifier).initializeForSource(widget.source);
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_videoController == null) {
      return const ColoredBox(
        color: Colors.black,
        child: Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC)),
        ),
      );
    }

    final aiState = ref.watch(aiSchedulerProvider);
    final sessionSnapshot = ref.watch(mediaSessionControllerProvider);
    final player = ref.read(nativeMediaSessionProvider).player;

    ref.listen<AiSchedulerState>(aiSchedulerProvider, (previous, next) {
      if (player == null) return;

      if (next.isBufferingForAi && player.state.playing) {
        ref.read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier).pause();
      } else if (!next.isBufferingForAi && previous?.isBufferingForAi == true) {
        ref.read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier).play();
      }
    });

    if (sessionSnapshot.status == PlayerStatus.error) {
      return ColoredBox(
        color: Colors.black,
        child: Center(
          child: Card(
            color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
            margin: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.error_outline,
                    color: Colors.redAccent,
                    size: 48,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  const Text(
                    'Native Player Error',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    sessionSnapshot.error?.message ?? 'Unknown playback error',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.white70),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => ref
                        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
                        .openSource(widget.source),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                    label: const Text('Retry Playback'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ColoredBox(
      color: Colors.black,
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: [
          Center(child: Video(controller: _videoController!)),
          SubtitleOverlay(segment: aiState.activeSegment),
          _TrackSelectorOverlay(sessionSnapshot: sessionSnapshot),
          if (kDebugMode)
            Positioned(
              bottom: 80,
              right: 16,
              child: FloatingActionButton.small(
                backgroundColor: Colors.black54,
                child: const Icon(Icons.bug_report, color: Colors.redAccent),
                onPressed: () {
                  showModalBottomSheet(
                    context: context,
                    isScrollControlled: true,
                    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                    builder: (context) => const DiagnosticLogOverlay(),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          if (aiState.isBufferingForAi)
            Container(
              color: Colors.black54,
              child: Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const CircularProgressIndicator(color: Color(0xFF7C5CFC)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Text(
                      'Refilling Subtitle Buffer (${aiState.subtitleAhead.inSeconds}s / ${AppConstants.initialSubtitleBuffer.inSeconds}s)',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    const Text(
                      'Video paused to guarantee synchronized Vietnamese subtitles',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _TrackSelectorOverlay extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _TrackSelectorOverlay({required this.sessionSnapshot});
  final MediaSessionSnapshot sessionSnapshot;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final audioTracks = sessionSnapshot.trackSet.audioTracks;
    final subtitleTracks = sessionSnapshot.trackSet.subtitleTracks;

    if (audioTracks.length <= 1 && subtitleTracks.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return Positioned(
      top: 12,
      right: 12,
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (audioTracks.length > 1) ...[
                PopupMenuButton<AudioTrack>(
                  icon: const Icon(
                    Icons.audiotrack,
                    size: 18,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  tooltip: 'Select Audio Track',
                  onSelected: (track) {
                    ref
                        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
                        .selectAudioTrack(track);
                  },
                  itemBuilder: (context) {
                    return audioTracks.map((a) {
                      return PopupMenuItem<AudioTrack>(
                        value: a,
                        child: Text('${a.label} (${a.language ?? 'unknown'})'),
                      );
                    }).toList();
                  },
                ),
              ],
              IconButton(
                icon: Icon(
                  ref.watch(dubbingControllerProvider)
                      ? Icons.record_voice_over
                      : Icons.voice_over_off,
                  size: 18,
                  color: ref.watch(dubbingControllerProvider)
                      ? const Color(0xFF7C5CFC)
                      : Colors.white,
                ),
                tooltip: 'AI Vietnamese Dubbing',
                onPressed: () => ref
                    .read(dubbingControllerProvider.notifier)
                    .toggleDubbing(),
              ),
              if (subtitleTracks.isNotEmpty) ...[
                PopupMenuButton<PlayerSubtitleTrack?>(
                  icon: const Icon(
                    Icons.subtitles,
                    size: 18,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  tooltip: 'Select Subtitle Track',
                  onSelected: (track) {
                    ref
                        .read(mediaSessionControllerProvider.notifier)
                        .selectSubtitleTrack(track);
                  },
                  itemBuilder: (context) {
                    return [
                      const PopupMenuItem<PlayerSubtitleTrack?>(
                        value: null,
                        child: Text('Off / AI Pipeline Default'),
                      ),
                      ...subtitleTracks.map((s) {
                        return PopupMenuItem<PlayerSubtitleTrack?>(
                          value: s,
                          child: Text('${s.label} [${s.classification.name}]'),
                        );
                      }),
                    ];
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

enum ModelDownloadState { notDownloaded, downloading, ready, failed }

class ModelDownloadProgress {
  const ModelDownloadProgress({
    required this.modelId,
    required this.state,
    required this.downloadedBytes,
    required this.totalBytes,
    this.currentFile,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final String modelId;
  final ModelDownloadState state;
  final int downloadedBytes;
  final int totalBytes;
  final String? currentFile;
  final String? errorMessage;

  double get progress =>
      totalBytes > 0 ? (downloadedBytes / totalBytes).clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
}

class ModelDownloadException implements Exception {
  ModelDownloadException(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  String toString() => message;
}

class ModelIntegrityException implements Exception {
  ModelIntegrityException(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  String toString() => 'ModelIntegrityException: $message';
}

      type: AiModelType.vad,
      version: 'git-60b7ffa',
      languages: ['all'],

          url: '$_sileroBase/silero_vad.onnx',
          bytes: 2327524,
